For those that have followed my work for some time, you're likely aware that [I publish an annual set of predictions](https://substack.com/redirect/396ec4e6-f739-46ef-a7eb-e9b722c032ef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). While most people who produce such lists do so for the year ahead, I find it easier to identify developments when looking out five years. Shorter time frames, in my analysis, make it difficult to distinguish noise from signal As such, [my annual piece has always focused on the global developments to watch in the forthcoming five years](https://substack.com/redirect/396ec4e6-f739-46ef-a7eb-e9b722c032ef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Before I invite you to join me in developing my 2024 list of global developments to watch over the next five years, let's review two "wins," two "losses," and two "yet-to-be determined outcomes" from prior years.
### Pandemic Warning? Yes.
In 2015, I warned of a potential global pandemic and suggested that it may be caused by an airborne disease (at the time, I suggested Middle East Respiratory Syndrome (MERS) as the most likely) that would spread more rapidly than the attention grabbing Ebola disease that was dominating headlines. See #9 on my [15 Predictions for '15-'20](https://substack.com/redirect/34e7d9c2-d3f5-478a-93fd-de3491f39264?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):

### Domestic Instability in Saudi Arabia? No!
In 2016, I predicted that Saudi Arabia would face domestic unrest within its borders as a fall in oil prices would lead to decreased social spending, which in turn might result in popular calls for more freedom. While the domestic instability failed to materialize, the Kingdom did begin to liberalize social policy with [the rise of Mohammed bin Salman](https://substack.com/redirect/530c63fe-2120-43ad-a32d-a362d742de83?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). ### Bitcoin Boom? Yup!
My January 2017 set of predictions included the following text: "**[Currency wars](https://substack.com/redirect/7486dae4-e1af-460f-8072-3c133236be1d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[intensify](https://substack.com/redirect/7486dae4-e1af-460f-8072-3c133236be1d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), leading to a global investor stampede for non-printable currencies like **gold** and **Bitcoin** , both of which surge to all-time highs." Well, that's _exactly_ what happened: Bitcoin went from under $1000 in January 2017 to over $60,000 in November 2021. **If Bob Ferguson had his way, we would have followed Oregon down this dangerous path of legalizing drugs and most likely be in a similar pickle. I proudly supported the legalization of cannabis in 2012, but cannabis and fentanyl are not the same and our next governor can't support legalizing dangerous drugs.[If you agree, add your name to my petition.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75409890/444592091/-774169363?source=MM_EM_PT_90DO_231218_1_1&refcode2=865d78c7-019e-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&contactdata=LUx3A+YYPpP5UQ4DmgEHerCfF5wO77BVe4A4j7y1oC840zEuJfb3XbcjnwZa/mf+&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MzAxMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NjVkNzhjNy0wMTllLWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjNmMzYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9VyNqfqcN6DlnGV0q29cJBJ8eJSl5sPk9Qy-u3hjylM=&emci=5f1cc781-979b-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&emdi=865d78c7-019e-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&ceid=45626167)**

I will prioritize public safety by making sure we have accountability for public drug use to make sure people complete substance abuse programs to defeat their addiction.

clean_body: SB3 and SB4 head to Greg Abbott’s desk. We must fight back. Peter, Today Texas Governor Greg Abbott signed into law two of the most extreme, anti-immigrant bills our state has ever seen. Here’s a snapshot: SB 4 is a “show me your papers” bill that gives local law enforcement sweeping power to stop people they think are migrants, and empowers judges to issue removal orders without due process. SB 3 would send an additional $1.54 BILLION in taxpayer funds for a state border wall and funding for Greg Abbott’s illegal and draconian Operation Lone Star These bills are not only wrong— they are unconstitutional. That’s why I joined fellow Texans and members of Congress in urging the Biden administration to block these laws in court before they’re enacted. I want to tell you more about these terrible bills in a second.= **= Peter, Governor Abbott has spent every waking hour these past few years antagonizing border communities and families seeking asylum. His administration has spent BILLIONS in taxpayer funding to build a ridiculous state border wall and install razor wire buoys in the Rio Grande River to intentionally harm asylum seekers.But these two bills are an entirely new chapter in his anti-immigrant crusade. By signing these bills, Texas law enforcement will be empowered to harass and detain anyone they suspect of being undocumented. That will undoubtedly lead to innocent Texans being racially profiled, and asylum seekers who are here LEGALLY to be denied their due process. It’s cruel, anti-immigrant, wasteful, and unconstitutional. That’s why my colleagues and I are fighting back and urging the Biden Administration to challenge them in court. = Thank you for your support, -Greg Greg Casar Congressman Texas Congressional District 35 ****=** | ****** ---|---

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: The Supreme Court will hear a case to decide whether to restrict mifepristone. My response:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
They’re claiming they know the science better than the actual scientists and experts in drug safety and efficacy.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=1859%2E4032634%2EEo8wRs)
---
The Supreme Court recently announced they'll hear a case on whether to restrict access to mifepristone — an FDA-approved medication that abortion patients have used for decades. Before I continue, a few important things to make clear: Mifepristone is safe — and mifepristone is still legal in 37 states right now. This will be the biggest abortion case to be decided by the Supreme Court since _Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health Organization_ — the case that overturned _Roe v. Wade_. Since then, states have tried to make it extremely difficult to access this medication — or have banned it altogether. Anti-abortion extremists’ next crusade is to ban mifepristone nationwide. So my colleague Tammy Baldwin and I introduced a resolution in the Senate expressing support for mifepristone. The resolution affirms Congress’ stance that we trust the FDA to determine the safety and efficacy of drugs — not politically motivated institutions, politicians, or judges. So far, this resolution has the support of 40 senators, organizations like Planned Parenthood and the Center for Reproductive Rights, and zero Republicans. [**I’m going to continue to pull every lever I can to protect abortion access in our country. If you’re able to, please donate $28 or anything you can to support our pro-abortion rights campaign so we can continue to fight back against extremists trying to take away our freedoms.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/1046?amount=28&t=8&akid=1859%2E4032634%2EEo8wRs)

I am fed up with extremists trying to turn back the clock and deny women reproductive health care — especially after decades of science that show that medication abortion is safe and effective. They claim they know the science better than the actual scientists and experts in drug safety and efficacy. Any threat to the accessibility of this drug nationwide would be devastating to both health care providers and patients across the country. In states that already restrict access to mifepristone, patients are more likely to seek procedural abortions later in their pregnancies, resulting in higher costs and elevated health risks. Beyond abortion care, mifepristone is also used to treat miscarriages. This latest development just makes the already-obvious even more painfully obvious: Overturning Roe was never simply about leaving abortion policy to the states. Right-wing extremists and MAGA Republicans are attacking national abortion access at every angle, everywhere. This is about grabbing power however they can. [**I’m going to keep fighting my heart out in Congress to protect abortion access — but I can’t do it alone. We've got to keep pushing, and that's only possible with the support of grassroots supporters like you. body:
https://www.everyaction.com/ [https://www.everyaction.com/]
Dear Peter,
I’m grateful for all your help and support this past year as we took back our House majority in Virginia and wanted to update you on our work!
I am honored that I have been appointed as the Chair of the House Education Committee for the coming legislative term. This role presents an incredible opportunity to shape the future of education in Virginia! We must ensure that every student has access to a world-class education that prepares them for success in our rapidly changing world.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/edu%20chair.jpeg]
It’s time we raise teacher pay to retain Virginia’s amazing teachers. I look forward to investing in our school construction shortfall and, as someone who’s substitute taught, I know the value of expanding innovative programs, like the community school model, to bring critical services to our students, and expand our investment in mental health care access.
Our Team, through The Impact Center, helped our biggest slate of candidates yet this year! We canvassed and invested in over 22 candidates for the General Assembly in every corner of Virginia AND supported dozens of local candidates. We contributed over $150,000 and knocked on over 25,000 doors this cycle.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/Impact%20Center%20Prospectus%20%285%29.png]
As you know, we are unable to accept support during the legislative session. Please consider making a contribution as your support is crucial as we work together to build an equitable and inclusive Virginia. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/samrasoul]
Thank you,
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/signature%20sam.png]
Del. Sam Rasoul

#
Peter — here are three ways your support will help us defeat Josh Hawley, elect Lucas Kunce, and flip Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat next November:
**ADS —** Online, on TV, on the radio... all these ads are how we’ll be able to get Lucas’ message in front of voters at scale and keep holding Hawley accountable for betraying our country and failing Missouri during his time in the U.S. Senate.
**Here’s just one example:**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/40291?refcode=em20231218-4417&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=4417%2E614464%2EZvJtgt)

## Welcome to the MIGOP Newsletter!
Each Monday, the Michigan Republican Party sends important information about what is happening within the party, state, and nation and how you can get involved.
---
|
---
|
---
Join fellow Republicans at special events around the state, such as the upcoming “[Campaign Academy](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=735d0934ac&e=a2af77507c)” hosted by the Wayne County Republican Committee. There will be great information for _any_ candidate and volunteer no matter where you live.

**ATTENTION PRECINCT DELEGATES!** Check out this helpful [resource](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=b0cefa5230&e=a2af77507c), which gives an overview of each Michigan Republican Party convention and when they take place at the county, district, and state levels. **Mark your calendars and stay tuned for more details!**
For more information about upcoming events, visit the [MIGOP events page](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=15ab8f84aa&e=a2af77507c).
|
---
|
---

National pollster and political analyst Richard Baris spent most of his show— _Inside the Numbers—_ on December 9 focused entirely on the state of Michigan and its important role in the 2024 election. Baris and Chairwoman Karamo had an informative 30-minute conversation you don’t want to miss. Check it out on [Rumble](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=8222d1496d&e=a2af77507c) or [Locals](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=1e97139eb4&e=a2af77507c).

The latest edition of _[Friday Lunch with Chair Karamo](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=05a69d0d04&e=a2af77507c)_ is now available on the MIGOP website. By Noon each Friday, a new interview with the Chairwoman will be posted.
|
---
|
---
**ALERT!****The MIGOP issued the following press release on December 16, 2023, regarding the recount efforts and failure of the Oakland County Board of Canvassers—Democrats _and Republicans_ —to protect our elections.**
*** * ***
**Royal Oak Recount Proceedings Get Heated Over Red Flags And Potential Voter Disenfranchisement**

The Oakland County Board of Canvassers, a bi-partisan, four-member board, comprised of two Democrats and two Republicans (nominated by the Oakland County Chair) is once again embroiled in election integrity issues and potential voter disenfranchisement in yesterday’s recount of the City of Royal Oak’s close Proposal B (rank choice voting) race.

Election Integrity Volunteer Investigators preparing for a recount initially raised red flags regarding the unusually high number of absent voter ballots that were sent to the voters but never cast. This prompted the citizen-led investigation unit to conduct a field canvassing mission of over one hundred households in Royal Oak. The results of this investigation found that for those individuals who answered their door, twenty-five voters spread throughout multiple households attested to having voted. However, further investigation revealed that Royal Oak's official city records indicate these Michiganders did not vote. **[READ MORE . . .](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=9a356ec860&e=a2af77507c)**

**WATCH!** Tim Vetter from [CheckMyVote.org](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=362b0a4185&e=a2af77507c) made [remarks](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=e0ec5c3863&e=a2af77507c) at the recount proceedings.

_**The Election Security Operations team at the MIGOP is actively seeking Republican volunteers for its 18 areas of responsibility in securing elections. For more information or to sign up, contact Phil O**_ _**’ Halloran at phil@migop.org.**_

|
---
| [ ](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=620739fd4d&e=a2af77507c)
---
Through the MIGOP Good Neighbor Program, you learn what **YOU** can do to secure Michigan’s elections. There are many different ways you can get involved and make a difference in your community’s election process. It starts with something simple but essential: _**making a connection with your local clerk.**_

To learn more about the Good Neighbor Program, visit the **[NEW GNP webpage](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=37e0d81bf1&e=a2af77507c)** or contact coordinators Ken Beyer (District 4 Chair) at **kenbeyer@protonmail.com** and Ann Clark (Wayne County Republican Committee Chair) at **annpatriot@protonmail.com**.
|
---
|
---
As a follow up to a previous ruling in favor of election security, in a 3–0 decision, the Michigan Court of Appeals [upheld lower court decisions](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=084f878838&e=a2af77507c) that President Trump can remain on the Michigan presidential primary ballot in 2024, **_marking another significant victory in the fight for ballot freedom_**.
|
---
|
---
From _Breitbart News_ : “[Christian Former Military Officer Beheads Satanic Statue at Iowa State Capitol](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=4723e7ab44&e=a2af77507c).” For more information, visit the GiveSendGo fundraising [campaign](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=581ad96ae1&e=a2af77507c) for Michael Cassidy.
* * *
As further proof we must elect Republicans who both understand the U.S. Constitution and work hard to protect our freedoms, both Democrat Michigan senators Debbie Stabenow and Gary Peters voted for the outrageous $886 billion National Defense Authorization Act [this week](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=04527b504a&e=a2af77507c), which **_extended the domestic surveillance provisions_** via FISA by four months. The final roll call vote is [here](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=2f248fce9f&e=a2af77507c).
|
---
|
---
Get involved with the Michigan Republican Party! Learn more about your county, district, and state party leadership at [migop.org](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=4bfb6816c2&e=a2af77507c)[/about](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=2f899266e2&e=a2af77507c).

Stay connected with the MIGOP on [X](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=ddd6db4ab6&e=a2af77507c) (Twitter), [Truth Social](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=c645acfec3&e=a2af77507c), [Telegram](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=d036c6b965&e=a2af77507c), [Facebook](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=beb9dde139&e=a2af77507c), and [Instagram](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=c8159c35cf&e=a2af77507c).

I’m one of our Commonwealth’s number one fans, so there’s a lot more where that came from.

[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/75412238/444626921/-2079439380?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2023-12-18_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjEyODY3MjgzLTBkOWUtZWUxMS1iZWExLTAwMjI0ODIyM2YzNiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=n3DW65OMUj4qqr9wa1iZKd-2b_XocHIlYQOMzR3PvxY=)

name: Adam Schiff
subject: My North Star
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR SENATE
body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=4799%2E5257348%2EMYGPff ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Hey Derek — My
phone sent me a throwback photo as a memory the other day, and I had to
share it with you.

In 2002, I brought my daughter Lexi to the Capitol with me for work. She
was only four, but already had a better fashion sense than her dad.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=dec2023_abs_em.181qVM&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20231218_PM2_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=4799%2E5257348%2EMYGPff ]Adam with Lexi in Washington DC wearing sunglasses

Right after this photo was taken, we ran into Nancy Pelosi, who was the
minority whip at the time. “This is Nancy Pelosi,” I explained. “She’s our
whip. If you don’t vote the way she wants, she has a whip.”

“Don’t tell her that,” the Speaker said, then got down on her knees so she
was eye-level with Lexi and said: “It’s a candy whip. It’s a candy whip.”

(“It’s not a candy whip,” I said to myself.)

Twenty years later, Lexi is a grown-up. She still has better taste than
me. And sometimes, she even writes emails to send to you, which I
appreciate more than words could say.

What’s also remained the same since this photo was taken is my fight in
Congress. The North Star that has guided me during my time in Congress,
and now in my campaign for the United States Senate, is what is best for
the next generation.

I also want to make my kids proud of what their father did when he had a
chance to serve.

That’s why I’m fighting for our democracy and protecting the right to
vote. The right to vote is foundational — the right upon which all others
rest. Destroy the foundation, and the walls of our democracy come
crumbling down.

It’s why I’m fighting against climate change and supporting transformative

| | Check this out...

Take a look at this...

I just heard about Gary Gadwa, a search-and-rescue veteran of nearly 40 years. He stood up to Michael Boren, who was planning to build an airstrip on his property in Northern Idaho.

Gary was worried it'd mess up the local environment and wasn't even good for rescues.

What does Boren do?

He gets the airstrip approved and then sues Gary and a bunch of other folks who opposed him.

**_Classic move to shut people up._**

But here's the kicker – the Idaho court throws out the lawsuit, calling it for what it is: a tactic to scare people into silence.

Boren's not happy, so he's taking it to the Supreme Court. FIRE, this free speech group, is backing Gary now.

This is exactly why we need anti-SLAPP laws in Idaho!!

An anti-SLAPP law could dissuade rich and powerful folks from using courts as weapons against regular people just speaking their minds. It's about keeping our right to speak up without the fear of getting dragged through expensive lawsuits.

I have a bill making the rounds right now that has support from both sides of the aisle.

So, _under normal circumstances_ , I don't see why it wouldn't pass.

They just passed the same law in Utah this year. And a handful of other states are picking it up too.

Did you know that Idaho is one of only 18 states with ZERO anti-SLAPP protection?

But still...

**We need to get LOUD about this. **

Because we need laws that protect us from being bullied into silence.

| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan – then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I’ve dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? | Friend, I'm sorry to write so late but I just got off a campaign conference call and saw the good news. It is undeniable and electric - [today's latest polls](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=d3f6387e99&e=5bb5efcda7) show we can win this race with your help.

Consider:
>> [President Trump is crushing Biden](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=2a0ccda04e&e=5bb5efcda7) in every swing state and overall.
>> 7 in 10 Asian Americans in the United States believe the country is headed in the wrong direction and a majority hold a disfavored view of the Biden Administration, according to a new poll from [AAPI Data](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=044cc6bb0f&e=5bb5efcda7) and [The Associated Press-NORC Center for Public Affairs Research](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=75e078f104&e=5bb5efcda7).
>> [Black voters are giving up on Biden](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=109d2e2ae1&e=5bb5efcda7), moving towards President Trump _en masse_.
>> UNHEARD OF in politics where Hispanic Democrats outnumber Hispanic Republicans by over 14%, all voting [Hispanics now support President Trump over Biden](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=db7369c779&e=5bb5efcda7)!
>> And an [ AP-NORC poll of U.S. adults](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=444801c487&e=5bb5efcda7), 75% said they believe the country is headed in the wrong direction.
>> NOW THIS WEEK MARYLAND GOP voters' support for President Trump has jumped to [4](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=746552d119&e=5bb5efcda7)[9pts above the field, to a 62% lead](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=102bdeab76&e=5bb5efcda7)! That means in my race in District Six, we know his lead is over 70% and higher.
>> Independents are [now surging their vote for President Trump](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=1e9a1b1698&e=5bb5efcda7) at nearly 10% more than Biden nationally. And in District Six, we have thousands of swing Independents and swing Democrats. That means as your America First candidate with the voter demographic support that we already possess in District Six, and with your help and the grace of Almighty God, **_we can win this seat by at least 10 points_**.
>> and the Liberal-leaning Cook Political Report now lists District Six as an open seat no longer safe for Democrats.

District Six voters includes over 14% African-American/Black, 12% Hispanic, 10% Asian and 64% Caucasian and Other demographics.

_I am the candidate in this race that is widely well-known for my conservative constitutional work in all District Six Counties, in 2016 even flipping and winning three large Hillary Clinton precincts in Montgomery County_. And as State Delegate, I also worked hard for and won majorities and large percentages of several of our important demographics and submitted and passed several pieces of common sense legislation with large support from across the political spectrum. And, as **_the only person in this race who has publicly endorsed and supports President Trump to be our 47th President_** , this shows that my candidacy has the strength for winning both the primary and general election because Marylanders want a genuine, proven fighter for our families and freedom.

This also means that our $1.6 million investment in my race last year, and additional close to $200,000 in many of these crucial precincts since 2016, will pay off with your help today, as the highest investment for name recognition of any candidate in the race. I cannot rely upon our past investments alone - we must raise a war chest _now_.

I have the elected and 20+ year professional fighting experience in the 'Arena,' and unbending loyalty to our conservative principles and constitution, to win and I am asking for your immediate support to reach our first FEC report goal. Right now I need to raise another $10,000 by tomorrow evening to not fall behind the Democrats. Please double your contribution TONIGHT. CONTRIBUTE NOW AT THIS SECURE LINK: [https://secure.anedot.com/dan-cox-for-congress-inc/donate](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=94e881970a&e=5bb5efcda7) .
Thank you.

Freedom and victory,

Fmr. Delegate Dan Cox
Conservative America First Republican Candidate for Congress, CD6-MD
P.S. - I pledge to be your voice and your proven, consistent advocate. Please help me tonight as I need to have the funds to defeat the Democrats' schemes to plan to try and buy this seat with hard-Left dark money. HELP ME RUN THIS RACE AND SAY GOODBYE TO THE BIDEN ADMINISTRATION. Thank you!

body:
| Friend,

**My name is Janelle Bynum and I’m running for Congress in Oregon’s 5th Congressional District** – one of the most-competitive, Republican-held seats in the country. I wanted to take a moment to reach out, personally, to introduce myself and welcome you to our grassroots campaign.

**As a legislator, a mother of four, and a small business owner, I have never shied away from an opportunity to uplift our community and make it possible for all Oregonians to get ahead.**

I am proud to have earned a reputation as a tireless champion for real progress. I’ve fought to defend reproductive freedom, safeguard our civil rights, expand affordable housing, lower the cost of healthcare and prescription drugs, and create pathways to success for the next generation so everyone has a fair shot.

**And now, I’m running to bring this fight to Congress.** [Please, will you consider joining our movement to deliver progress and change by splitting $10 between the Voter Protection Project and me today?](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/58391?t=6&akid=12153%2E878179%2EWfxe-t) | [**DONATE »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/58391?t=7&akid=12153%2E878179%2EWfxe-t)
---
Friend, here in Happy Valley, where my husband and I chose to raise our children, too many families are struggling.

The skyrocketing costs of education, healthcare, and housing are making it impossible for anyone to get ahead. And the worst part is: It seems like no one in DC is listening or fighting for solutions.

Our Congresswoman, Lori Chavez-DeRemer, and her Republican colleagues are too consumed with the partisan political games in DC to push for change.

**Our community deserves a Congresswoman who understands our needs and who is prepared to deliver results** – no matter who tries to stand in the way. That’s exactly why I’m running.

[I hope you’ll consider splitting a donation between the Voter Protection Project and my campaign to help me flip this ultra-competitive, toss up seat and deliver real change for working families. I can’t do this alone, so I really appreciate your grassroots support!](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/58391?t=8&akid=12153%2E878179%2EWfxe-t)
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Janelle Bynum and VPP will go through immediately:

name: David Horowitz
subject: Barack Obama’s revolution
body:
America is on the brink of destruction.

| |
---
| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. And ruthless hunters are taking advantage of the lack of regulations. They’re viciously targeting and gunning down helpless wolves. But it’s not enough to kill them: they make these helpless creatures suffer needlessly, murdering them with inhumane hunting methods. They choke wolves to death with neck snares. They chase them down with helicopters. They even dynamite nursing wolf mamas and their helpless baby pups sleeping inside their dens. **And it’s all completely legal.**

Believe it or not, wolves are vital to the ecosystems and public lands they live on. They help keep elk and deer populations in check, allowing other plant and animal species to thrive. What’s more, the remains of their kills redistribute nutrients and feed scavengers. They truly are a keystone species -- maintaining balance across the same environments that sustain people, too!
That’s why each death of this iconic species is a big deal. But a Trump-era rule rolled back federal protections for gray wolves. And now, the trophy hunting lobby has pushed for even more cruel and inhumane laws throughout wolves’ natural habitats. Even worse, **the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service could reinstate federal protections in the Northern Rocky states for these creatures -- but has still failed to do so!**
We can’t stand aside while our wolves are under attack. If brutal trophy hunters won’t even spare the lives of innocent young pups, this majestic species won’t stand a chance. Friends of the Earth is fighting with everything we have to protect the Endangered Species Act. These protections block greedy fossil fuel companies from exploiting our public lands for profit. But they’re now at risk to be opened up to fracking, drilling, and mining that create pollution and __harm wildlife and nearby communities, too.__ That’s why we’ve collected thousands of comments from supporters just like you -- urging our elected leaders to put an end to these vicious attacks against this vital legislation.

The attacks from the Yemen-based rebels have forced at least five major freight firms to sail around Africa [to avoid the Suez Canal](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvgzAQRn-N2Yzss4EweOjClq4d0cU-x24NRnAJyr-v0rnLt3zS09P7us5XzCWv909cyHGsM3rOT5o1SD1KMLNtgotEQKYhpwcF49gp1TfJIaiLNV2wprNx7DUSDj56b4LqYRihyQ4UGA161KrrNLQ9KG9HHc0tdhb6IKyikLnu7XfNKyeK5VWftLe-Lk1xiXk7hPkQMAmYzvNs_Xrz71PA9EYLmDS85yJgSvWUqT44ZYnM6H8OmVe5U5AHoeS0EzKt8l7qDYs8HttWXtInzGubeCnN7sJ25lLy0Q_CqvuCufyJ8P9dfgMAAP__GMZjOw), causing delays for a significant portion of world shipping. Today's edition is sponsored by . | U.S. to Protect Red Sea Shipping The U.S. military is set to launch an in the Red Sea backed by an international alliance to combat growing attacks on shipping by Iran-backed Houthi rebels. The attacks from the Yemen-based rebels have forced at least five major freight firms to sail around Africa , causing delays for a significant portion of world shipping. The rebels' goal is to cut off trade with Israel. The new military alliance, dubbed Operation Prosperity Guardian, was and will include the U.K., Canada, France, and other European nations. Storm Knocks Out Power for 700,000 A major storm lashed the Atlantic coast Monday with heavy rain and thunderstorms, leaving almost and 59 million people from Virginia to Maine under flood alerts. More than 5 inches of rain hit New Jersey and Pennsylvania by Monday morning, and wind gusts along the southern New England shoreline. Most of the power outages were in Massachusetts and Maine. Officials have reported at least four deaths so far. The storm was by Monday evening, though the rain could turn to snow in some areas. School closings and flight cancellations were widespread, and it's unclear when normal operations will resume. Nippon Steel to Buy Iconic U.S. Steel U.S. Steel, the company that helped build America into an industrial giant, nearly $15 billion by Nippon Steel, Japan's largest steelmaker. The news brought immediate opposition from some members of Congress. Nippon Steel said it would honor all union agreements at U.S. Steel, which will keep its name and its headquarters in Pittsburgh, where it was founded in 1901 and later became . Already lining up against the deal were, who oppose allowing foreign ownership of what is still a major U.S. manufacturer. The steelworkers union has also expressed its opposition. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He’s taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. body:
No images? [Click here](https://caucusroom.cmail20.com/t/i-e-adltrjt-trhiujldw-j/) [](https://caucusroom.cmail20.com/t/i-l-adltrjt-trhiujldw-r/) **Caucus Room Members** **Caucus Room History****Caucus Room will be implementing a "Factory Reset" January 1, 2024** _Want to Win again?_ When Caucus Room was formed in 2019 it was envisioned as a virtual meeting place for conservatives to gather with their conservative neighbors to discuss issues and organize solutions without the threat of retaliation or cancelling as had been demonstrated by other virtual gathering places. Conservatives felt ignored, isolated and without support. It was created for those who wanted to promote conservative ideals and principles in the political realm.When Covid became a real threat during the 2020 election cycle, Caucus Room pivoted to support the right of assembly and became the virtual assembly site for multiple local, county and state nominating conventions.In 2023, as in-person assemblies have returned, Caucus Room is returning to its original purpose: a local gathering place for conservatives to meet together with their neighbors virtually. It is a place where those who want to accomplish something can safely gather with those around them who want to work together.As I imagine what we face in winning elections and moving societal norms, I think about a large football stadium holding 100,000 fans looking down on the players waging hard-charging, head banging gridiron combat to move a little leather ball a few yards at a time. Most conservatives sit in the stands and root for their team. The opponent is satisfied to move the ball a few yards at a time with a mix of running plays and short passes. We wait for a long bomb pass to win the game in a close contest between opposing philosophies. When the pass doesn't work, we complain about the quarterback, or the coach, or the referees, or whatever, and we go home unhappy. What we really need are more skilled lineman, better plays and a winning strategy - Things we can supply. But there have not been enough of us willing to put in the time, resources and effort to do what it takes to change the outcome of the game. We prefer to watch, and then complain if we lose. Caucus Room is for the 10% of us who believe each generation must re-win liberty for the next generation. It is easy to forget that only a minority of Americans wanted to leave Great Britain in 1776, or that Abraham Lincoln, the first Republican President, won with less than 40% of the popular vote in 1860. Trump lost the 2020 election because of voter swings in only a handful of counties in a handful of states, just like he won in 2016 by only a handful of counties in a handful of states. Caucus Room is simply a tool for those who want to win again, county by county.We will find out in January whether those who want to put in the effort and resources required to win on the field value Caucus Room as part of their effort. This tool is designed for those on the field. Losing teams struggle keeping fans.**But winning is contagious!** Merry Christmas!John CoorsManager, Caucus Room LLCjohnc@caucusroom.com

subject: Our culture has a sick hatred for integrity and achievement
body:
I learned firsthand how our culture despises achievement

[](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37083%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=0nZop5Sqjv80rktBavLc%2bQ&sysid=1)
Friend,

I learned firsthand how our culture despises achievement and wishes to destroy anyone willing to challenge the status quo, big government, or the Fake News media machine.

When I was ousted from Project Veritas, two big things (one you haven’t heard about) happened to me.

FIRST: The media launched a vicious smear campaign against me like I’ve never seen before. **Make no mistake:** _They identified this as an opportunity to “cancel” me forever_ and tried everything in their power to destroy me and everything I’ve ever stood for.

They failed.

SECOND: I received an OVERWHELMING amount of support from patriots across the country. These brave men and women defended me, but more importantly, they stood up for the principles of liberty and free speech.

**One of my top supporters was The Atlas Society.**

Jennifer Grossman, the CEO of The Atlas Society, proudly stood by my side and even invited me to speak with a gathering of the organization’s top student leaders about free speech and how Howard Roark, the fictional hero of _The Fountainhead_ by Ayn Rand, remains my inspiration to act with integrity.

Which is why I am personally reaching out to you.

I told Jennifer I would help The Atlas Society raise $25,000 in the next 48 hours by personally contacting my online supporters. **[Please consider making an URGENT donation of any amount to The Atlas Society by clicking here.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37084%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=xQydvCCwbcBl%2bKx8sT0IPw&sysid=1)**

[Donate >>](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37095%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=F25BhFxZu%2fwUQ9Ykpod4HA&sysid=1)

Let me tell you more about The Atlas Society and how they are fundamentally changing the direction of our country.

_I will also tell you HOW The Atlas Society is spreading its message in what I consider one of the most innovative methods I’ve EVER seen a nonprofit organization engage in before._

_**_So keep reading_!**_

My mentor, Andrew Breitbart, reminds us that politics is downstream from culture. But what is culture downstream from? Answer: Philosophy. That’s where The Atlas Society shines, engaging young people with the virtues of reason, achievement, and benevolent self-interest in wildly creative, artistic ways.

Have you ever read Ayn Rand’s _Atlas Shrugged_ or _The Fountainhead_?

These books changed how I saw the world and my role in it.

But they are 700+ pages long!

**Jennifer shared this terrifying statistic with me:** Daily reading of books among young people has fallen from 70% in the late 1970s to 12% today.

So, how do we preserve Rand’s role as the greatest all-time recruiter for liberty? That’s where The Atlas Society gets creative! They leverage art and technology to create programming for “ _skimmers, swimmers, and deep divers_.”
**Skimmers:** Social media memes and animated videos -- every single one of their 50 posts a week gets 40K comments, shares, and likes. The “Draw My Life” videos on concepts like Capitalism, Property Rights, and Free Speech reach MILLIONS of viewers. Links invite young people on a journey for deeper intellectual exploration.

The American revolution was triggered by the Boston Tea Party, a rebellion against the British empire imposing taxes on New England tea merchants while eliminating taxes on the tea company owned by the British aristocracy. Furious with a blatant violation of their rights to “no taxation without representation,” the colonists boarded the ship carrying the King’s tea and dumped it in Boston Harbor.
In the revolution that followed, America’s citizen soldiers defeated history’s most powerful empire, freed themselves from a corrupt collusion between money and government, and won our independence.
Today, after the failed policies of the Trump and Biden administrations, **the top 1% now owns more of our country’s wealth than the entire 60% in the middle**.
The Trump Biden lockdown economy has saddled us with an unacceptable crisis. Working Americans can no longer afford life in America. Everyday Americans, on average, are borrowing $5000 a year on credit cards to meet their needs.
**We are facing a disparity in income that is downright dystopian. Income inequality today is worse than it was in 1774 before our revolution.**
So we are back to conditions we fought a revolution over. And is that any surprise when we have two parties in Washington who’s elected officials are indentured servants to their corporate donors and who claim to believe in democracy but really only when it’s convenient?
People across the political spectrum realize the system has failed. Our government, subverted by powerful monied interests, no longer works for them. And it has given us an economy that exploits the many to build the outsized wealth of a few in a new, emerging aristocracy.

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zopsgipso20bfaho48gh39koldkv4b571dl5rino_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c1g61o76cth2bs "Will you join me today and help me save our country?")**

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: Preserve America’s unique heritage and fight for our religious freedoms
body:
Our nation was founded on Christian principles, and the founders wanted our government to uphold those principles.

| | | [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z7fe5r0bpi8na1vqs3hqc81pjqma02vdbapb5e80_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c1i60or4cth2bs)
---
Hello, Revisionists would have you believe that our founders intended for a complete separation between Church and State and that Christianity should be absent from all aspects of our government. However, the reality is quite different. Our nation was founded on Christian principles, and the founders wanted our government to uphold those principles.

I’ve written a book whose title boldly declares what I know to be true: _America Is a Christian Nation_. Many would dispute that claim, but my book provides evidence for this truth using the very words and actions of the founders themselves. The book is a short read, accompanied by beautiful patriotic photos that I think you’ll appreciate.
---
[](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zpsf3umgfd7d052uf3393u0h0s106klgn4oqj2mg_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c1i60or4cth2bs)
---
| | I would love for you to read this book and discover the truth about our nation’s Christian heritage. And as a token of our appreciation for a gift to Pathway to Victory, we’ll not only send you this book, but also a brand new CD featuring some of our nation’s most patriotic songs from First Baptist Dallas’ renowned choir and orchestra. [https://secure.ptv.org/america-is-a-christian-nation-generous-kit-2](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zu0mkeic3r0edsoltg7ka4cubmr5g1m47pidrhqo_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c1i60or4cth2bs)

As believers, we must preserve America's unique heritage and fight for our religious freedoms. By understanding our nation's Christian roots, we can work to bring our country back to its founding principles. At the end of my book, I provide suggestions for how to do just that.

I hope you'll consider donating to _Pathway to Victory_ and receiving your copy of _America Is a Christian Nation_ so you can know without a doubt that the foundation of our country was solidly established in the principles of the Bible.

Gratefully,
Dr. Robert Jeffress
---

Prosecutors are finally moving to hold Scott Perry accountable for his role in undermining our Democracy, but we can't leave anything to chance. DONATE NOW to hold him accountable at the ballot box in 2024! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]

That means that we can beat Perry, BUT we can't take our foot off the gas, and that's why I'm asking you to make a contribution today! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
Scott Perry's very bad week makes one thing clear - The momentum is with us, and I hope you are as proud of what our campaign has accomplished since 2022 as I am. Getting to this point where we are poised to finally defeat Scott Perry was a team effort, and YOU have been an important part of our team. As we close in on the end of 2023, and our year end fundraising deadline, I am asking you to make a contribution to our campaign so we can finish what we started.
Together, we WILL defeat Scott Perry! Thank you for being a vital part of our team!
Shamaine

name: Cornel West 2024 Press Team
subject: Dr. Cornel West Calls on International Criminal Court to Investigate Likely War Crimes and Other Violations Committed by Benjamin Netanyahu and the Israel Defense Force
body:
I have seen enough, the global community has seen enough, and people of conscience have seen enough evidence of intentional barbaric and genocidal crimes committed by the Israel Defense Force at the behest of Prime Minister Netanyahu against the Palestinian people.

| | | [ ](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/r?u=L0vWSOy_QdrTdUsf_jo6vHg9O7xvFPHoRyHNejdpv68&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=icc2&n=1)
---
### **Dr. Cornel West Calls on International Criminal Court to Investigate Likely War Crimes and Other Violations Committed by Benjamin Netanyahu and the Israel Defense Force**
**Brother West will be holding a press conference at the Greenfield Manor, located at 4770 Greenfield Dr in Dearborn at 6:00 PM EST ahead of his keynote at Gaza Endures hosted by the Michigan Task Force for Palestine.** **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** **Tuesday, December 19th, 2023**
Cornel West for President
[press@cornelwest2024.com](mailto:press@cornelwest2024.com) Independent candidate for President of the United States, Dr. Cornel West today called on the International Criminal Court to launch an immediate investigation into likely war crimes committed by Israeli Prime Minister, Benjamin Netanyahu and the Israel Defense Force (IDF). As more details and evidence emerge, Brother West believes the global community must intervene and administer comeuppance for clear violations of Articles 6 (Genocide), 7 (Crimes Against Humanity), and 8 (War Crimes) of the Rome Statutes of the International Criminal Court as part of a larger set of immediate actions to protect Palestinian civilians including, but not limited to, an immediate and enforced ceasefire. Dr. West commented, “I have seen enough, the global community has seen enough, and people of conscience have seen enough evidence of intentional barbaric and genocidal crimes committed by the Israel Defense Force at the behest of Prime Minister Netanyahu against the Palestinian people.” He added, “In addition to the nearly 20,000 murders of civilians, almost half of them children, the IDF’s indiscriminate killings now include three precious Israeli hostages who were clearly waving a white flag of surrender before they were taken out. As more truth is elucidated from this fog of war, it’s clear there must be swift and righteous justice. The ICC must intervene and demonstrate that no one is above the laws of the global community or basic humanity - Netanyahu and members of the IDF have to answer for the likely war crimes they are committing.” West’s comments come after video evidence has emerged along with accounts of numerous people in Gaza who witnessed IDF soldiers intentionally shooting and killing Palestinian women and children taking refuge in a school and IDF soldiers burning food and humanitarian supplies meant for Gazans trapped in the southern part of the strip, in addition to reports by the Latin Patriarchate of Jerusalem that two Christian women were targeted and killed at Gaza’s Catholic Holy Family Parish in “cold blood” by an IDF sniper and the apparent use of white phosphorus, supplied by the United States, against Lebanese civilians and Hezbollah fighters. In addition to supplying the IDF with white phosphorus, Dr. West cited other examples of fact that the U.S. is a direct sponsor of, and complicit with myriad iniquitous activities and tactics used against Palestinian people by Israel. For instance, last week the Biden Administration vetoed a UN Security Council resolution calling for a ceasefire, and more recently Senate Democrats led by Majority Leader, Chuck Schumer, have delayed their holiday recess, in part, to secure $14.3 Billion of aid to Israel. “Instead of rushing to send more money to fuel the IDF’s genocidal war machine, the Senate should be rushing to prevent the loss of more innocent Palestinian and Israeli lives,” West remarked. “ Moreover, until the ICC completes their investigation the U.S. must cease all military aid to the State of Israel - I believe that most U.S. taxpayers don’t want to be associated with funding war crimes, spiritual obscenity, and moral bankruptcy.” Learn more about Cornel West at [CornelWest2024.com](CornelWest2024.com). Learn more about Dr. West’s Policy Pillars at [CornelWest2024.com/Platform](CornelWest2024.com/Platform). | \-- END --
---

name: Riley Gaines
subject: Join Me in Standing Up for Women’s Sports and American Values
body:
Below is an email I’m circulating to outstanding leaders and principled conservatives like you.

| | | [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c687248%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=BmVV6WJPsiffy7tuoqyhsg&sysid=1)
Hi Fellow American,

Below is an email I’m circulating to outstanding leaders and principled conservatives like you. I think you may be interested in seeing it.

Please review the message at your earliest convenience and let me know if you would like to participate.

Best wishes,

Riley Gaines

P.S. The deadline is approaching to raise $1.5 million to host my upcoming college campus tour. If you’d like to give online, here’s a secure link for you:
**[https://secured.leadershipinstitute.org/rgc-082424/](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c687249%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=E3YzVqny2jhXd8hctQ9coA&sysid=1)**

* * *

From: Riley Gaines <rileygaines@email.leadershipinstitute.org>
Send Date: August 9, 2023 9:55 AM
Subject: Did you see my announcement?

Dear Friend,

I hope you saw my announcement on Sean Hannity’s show that I’ve partnered with the Leadership Institute to launch the Riley Gaines Center.

I’m the 12-time All-American swimmer who speaks out against transgender ideology and fights to defend basic truths - that men are men and women are women.

The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute is now the exclusive headquarters of my work to lead conservatives of all types - patriots who will not be silenced by the weight of the left’s cultural pressure and who want to learn how to defend America’s freedoms.

When the left tries to shout you down profanely, when they viciously attack you - that’s when you know you’re saying the right things.

For those who are attacked, vilified, and persecuted for their support of America’s founding principles and traditional American values, the Riley Gaines Center sends a message that they are not alone - because I will stand bravely with them.

To train as many young people as I can to stand up for conservative principles, I must have the help of strong Leadership Institute supporters like you.

**[Will you help turn young men and women into Leaders for America?](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c687240%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=XGFVtWQ121HkRfWwNsZC%2fA&sysid=1)**

The Riley Gaines Center is the exclusive home of my work to lead this crucial cause through:

* Speaking events and media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women’s identity and uphold vital truths.

* A coalition of women, student athletes, parents, and those who have been harmed by radical transgender ideology, to join me in speaking out across the country.

* A fast-growing team of speakers and grassroots organizers, who will help turn those ready to defend freedom into champions who put their principles into action.

---
Through the Riley Gaines Center, my fellow Leadership Institute colleagues and I will identify, recruit, train, mentor, and empower students, athletes, and parents across the country to become campus, community, and national Leaders for America.

Not only will these young leaders help our country right now. They will stand up for our principles for decades to come.

**[By joining me and the Leadership Institute team with your contribution to this new effort, you make a powerful difference for conservatives across the country, from college campuses to the halls of power.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c687241%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=V0UIX1batywCtyKILts0%2bA&sysid=1)**

Thank you for your support and dedication to preserving commonsense truths and conservative principles in our country.

Stand bravely with me,

Riley Gaines
The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute
---
The Leadership Institute, 1101 N. Highland St., Steven P.J. Wood Building, Arlington, VA 22201, United States

---

American Update
---

body:
🙏 Coffee w/ YOU #16 | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/ne.gop/n41kepo7ku-12669592?e=25844e23a8)
---
| | [ ](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=fc13d2870e&e=25844e23a8)
---
| |
#### Good Morning Republicans,

As we near the most celebrated birthday of all time, where a Savior was born, I wanted to seek out the Word for His Truth, to set us free. I'm a numbers guy and always believe there is significance when a number stands out or can be correlated to an event. I know God loves numbers for He breathed life into a book called Numbers and the numbers like 40 or 7 or 4 have such significance in the Bible. This will be my 16th Coffee Newsletter and I decided to look up which Books were the 16th in the Old & New Testament. The 16th book of the Old Testament is Nehemiah and the 16th book of the New Testament is 2 Timothy. My favorite number is 5 (coincidence on 5 children? 🤷) so ...I chose the 1st chapter of each, starting on the 5th verse.

Nehemiah starts by exclaiming how bad things are in Jerusalem. He falls to his knees, mourns, fasts, and prays to the God of heaven.

_**Nehemiah 1:5-9** "Then I said, 'O Lord, God of heaven, the great and awesome God who keeps his covenant of unfailing love with those who love him and obey his commands, listen to my prayer! Look down and see me praying night and day for your people Israel. I confess that we have sinned against you. Yes, even my own family and I have sinned! We have sinned terribly by not obeying the commands, decrees, and regulations that you gave us through your servant Moses. Please remember what you told your servant Moses: 'If you are unfaithful to me, I will scatter you among the nations. But if you return to me and obey my commands and live by them, then even if you are exiled to the ends of the earth, I will bring you back to the place I have chosen for my name to be honored."_

**I could not find a better prayer for 2024.**

We HAVE sinned terribly here in America. Everyone of us...I have sinned...because we all fall short of His perfection. But, I take immense Hope in the promise and faithfully believe it applies to America... that if we return to Him and obey His commands and live by them, He will not forsake us. I faithfully believe that he has chosen this country to have His name honored along with Israel.
As I turned to 2 Timothy to guide my thoughts in crafting an end to a "shorter" newsletter, God's timing is always perfect. The Apostle Paul is writing to his dear friend Timothy and bringing him encouragement.

_**2 Tim 1:5-9** "I remember your genuine faith, for you share the faith that first filled your grandmother Lois and your mother, Eunice. And I know that same faith continues strong in you. This is why I remind you to fan into flames the spiritual gift God gave you when I laid my hands on you. For God has not given us a spirit of fear and timidity, but of power, love, and self-discipline. So never be ashamed to tell others about our Lord. And don't be ashamed of me, either, even though I'm in prison for him. With the strength God gives you, be ready to suffer with me for the sake of the Good News. For God saved us and called us to live a holy life. He did this, not because we deserved it, but because that was his plan from before the beginning of time - to show us his grace through Christ Jesus."_

**I could not have found a better verse for encouragement going into 2024.**

As I've written about being an Unapologetic Republican, I have mentioned in my speaking engagements at events to encourage others to be an _Unapologetic Christian_ as well. So, I encourage you this holiday season and beyond to never be ashamed to tell others about our Lord. Tell others about the birth of eternal salvation. Take the flame that has been given as a spiritual gift TO you FROM God to do goodness in your community. I have written numerous times about the objective of furthering our principles within our communities. This truly means to further our Christian principles within the community as well. To the leaders of the party, elected officials at all levels, chairs to county delegates...we were not given a spirit of fear and timidity, so commit ALL-in to the self-discipline, love, and power of goodness. We deserve nothing, yet God shows us His grace through a Savior from our sins. Commit all things to the Lord and I faithfully believe that His Will will be done in 2024.

The truth shall set us free.

With much blessings and wishing all a Merry Christmas and Happy Birthday Jesus,
---
|
---
| –Chairman Underwood

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2ze0dr4mausaaf76hfmngmfp17np7mcpb7f0pa6e8_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c1i62oj6c5h2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z579micutn4gsu2h5nee6c0b9b8fqnl6c7c3ng60_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c1i62oj6c5h2bs)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Fellow American, This is the first and last email I'll ever send you.

You see, I'm a little unsure about opening up to you this way.

**But the deck is stacked against us, my back is against the wall, and your response to this message will decide everything. **

My name is Pat Harrigan. You don't know me, but I'm a Green Beret veteran from North Carolina. I graduated from West Point, and I served 18 months in combat.

After that, my wife and I started a firearm parts company from our double-wide trailer - and grew it to become a successful, job-creating business. And most important of all, I'm the dad of two beautiful girls.

**I 'm also a GOP candidate in the MUST WIN race in NC-10, a district that Congressman McHenrys just retired from and one that WILL decide who controls Washington.**

Please review the message at your earliest convenience and let me know if you would like to participate.

Best wishes,

Riley Gaines

From: Riley Gaines <rileygaines@email.leadershipinstitute.org>
Send Date: August 9, 2023 9:55 AM
Subject: Did you see my announcement?

Dear Friend,

I hope you saw my announcement on Sean Hannity's show that I've partnered with the Leadership Institute to launch the Riley Gaines Center.

I'm the 12-time All-American swimmer who speaks out against transgender ideology and fights to defend basic truths - that men are men and women are women.

The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute is now the exclusive headquarters of my work to lead conservatives of all types - patriots who will not be silenced by the weight of the left's cultural pressure and who want to learn how to defend America's freedoms.

When the left tries to shout you down profanely, when they viciously attack you - that's when you know you're saying the right things.

For those who are attacked, vilified, and persecuted for their support of America's founding principles and traditional American values, the Riley Gaines Center sends a message that they are not alone - because I will stand bravely with them.

To train as many young people as I can to stand up for conservative principles, I must have the help of strong Leadership Institute supporters like you.

**[Will you help turn young men and women into Leaders for America?](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zcbv8p3eoo9lnjnp2hjt449j37o0thak974ka3cg_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c1i66o34cjh2bs)**

The Riley Gaines Center is the exclusive home of my work to lead this crucial cause through:

* Speaking events and media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women's identity and uphold vital truths.

* A coalition of women, student athletes, parents, and those who have been harmed by radical transgender ideology, to join me in speaking out across the country.

* A fast-growing team of speakers and grassroots organizers, who will help turn those ready to defend freedom into champions who put their principles into action.

---
Through the Riley Gaines Center, my fellow Leadership Institute colleagues and I will identify, recruit, train, mentor, and empower students, athletes, and parents across the country to become campus, community, and national Leaders for America.

Not only will these young leaders help our country right now. They will stand up for our principles for decades to come.

**[By joining me and the Leadership Institute team with your contribution to this new effort, you make a powerful difference for conservatives across the country, from college campuses to the halls of power.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z086mhm8g871f4ho77ppr2c3ovep908j4l25d2po_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c1i66o34cjh2bs)**

Thank you for your support and dedication to preserving commonsense truths and conservative principles in our country.

Stand bravely with me,

Riley Gaines
The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute

_\- NBC News, 12/9/23_ Looks familiar, doesn’t it? That’s because in October, we wrote to you when the GOP in Virginia attempted to do the same exact thing. Remember when they launched ads in the Commonwealth to highlight their “middle ground” stance on abortion ahead of the election? It was simply an attempt to distract you from the brutal reality of how harmful their intended abortion ban would’ve been. Now, after voters throughout the nation stood with Democrats and elected to protect reproductive health care in last month’s elections, Republicans running for Senate are realizing that they might need to change their stance if they want to win. **But we want to set the record straight... again. Friend,
Today, ALS advocate Ady Barkan would've celebrated his 40th birthday.
Even when he lost the ability to speak, Ady spent most days at the end of his life fighting for universal healthcare. In 2019, his call for Medicare For All brought that Congressional hearing to a standstill.
I've seen ALS — and countless other terminal illnesses — take far too many far too soon. I've seen what inaccessible palliative care does to families. Five years after Ady's powerful testimony, we still haven't done enough.
GoFundMe is not an acceptable substitute for Congressional action on healthcare reform.
Friend, I am proud to be the only practicing family doctors in the nation running for Congress to pass universal healthcare, and stories like Ady's are exactly why.

# [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=1435%2E552475%2EnqRTFk)
Hi Peter,
Recently, Bob released a series of reports exposing corporations that have been padding their profits by billions at the expense of Pennsylvanians. The report called out corporations for raising the prices of everyday goods far faster than the costs have gone up to produce them. It’s called “greedflation,” and it’s causing families across the Commonwealth to have to pay more.
**It’s just plain wrong, which is why Bob is working day in and day out to hold these corporations accountable.**
From fighting for tax cuts for the middle class, to rolling back excessive corporate tax cuts, to pushing for anti-price gouging legislation – Bob is fighting back on behalf of Pennsylvania families and working to put money back in your pockets.
[**If you know what it feels like to have sticker shock at the grocery store and to be making choices about what products you're buying for your family, then join Bob in this fight and add your name.**](https://go.bobcasey.com/signup/casey-em-20231218-greedflation/?refcode=em20231218-2&akid=1435%2E552475%2EnqRTFk)
**[Fight Greedflation: Sign On ››](https://go.bobcasey.com/signup/casey-em-20231218-greedflation/?refcode=em20231218-2&akid=1435%2E552475%2EnqRTFk)**
Bob is taking a stand against corporate greed and working to put money back in the pockets of working families. He’ll keep fighting to make corporations pay their fair share in taxes, fight corporate price gouging, and take on corporate monopolies.
[**Bob is fighting to hold these companies accountable and put money back in the pockets of working families. Add your name today to show your support.**](https://go.bobcasey.com/signup/casey-em-20231218-greedflation/?refcode=em20231218-2&akid=1435%2E552475%2EnqRTFk)
Bob is proud to be at the forefront of that fight and to have you by his side.
Thank you.
– Team Casey
