body:
Merry Christmas! Welcome to the December edition of the Moran Minuteman. | |
---
| | |
---
| | |
# Merry Christmas! Welcome to the December edition of **The Moran Minuteman**.
This monthly newsletter is our way of recognizing extraordinary efforts in Texas Congressional District 1 and providing an inside look into what happens behind the scenes in the life of a Congressman.
---
|
---
| Every fall leading up to an election year, candidates, including incumbent officeholders, must file paperwork communicating their intent to run for office. This year, the filing period was from November 11 - December 11. Now that the filing period has ended, I am humbled to report that I was the only candidate to file to serve the First Congressional District of Texas as its next U.S. Congressman for the 119th Congress, beginning January 2025 and continuing through the end of 2026. Preparing for a second term while finishing the first term in strong fashion will be my goal. Additionally, running uncontested will also provide an opportunity to help grow our House majority nationwide by working on behalf of other candidates in swing districts. It is imperative that we retain and grow the majority for the U.S. House.

Our team is proud of what we have accomplished in our first year in office, and we look forward to another term delivering strong, conservative results for so many friends and neighbors across East Texas and boldly speaking on behalf of hundreds of East Texans as we work together to change the course of this great Republic. Thank you for your continued support and prayers.
---
|
---
|
## Recognizing the 2023 Minuteman Honorees
When I think of East Texans, I think of the [Minutemen of the Revolutionary War](https://nathanielmoran.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0775eb7c3a967d340caf4e913&id=f7605ba7f2&e=bbce4dd6ad). Loyal to country and community, dependable, selfless, and ready at a moment's notice, the Minutemen were American heroes who helped turn the tide of the Revolutionary War. **Today's East Texans reflect those traits.** You are patriotic, dependable, and deeply committed to making our communities better.

Starting last March, each month, we recognized an East Texan who goes above and beyond in serving our region - someone who epitomizes the identity of a Minuteman. To wrap up the year, let's recognize them one more time for their extraordinary efforts on behalf of their fellow citizens. These are just a few of the great folks in East Texas who are truly agents of change for the better. And I know there are many more like them (and you). So, thank you for shining a light in this dark world!
---
| |
---
## Johnny Horne
Owner and operator of Cajun Tex restaurant, Johnny would stop and help anyone at a moment's notice. He was known to build wheelchair ramps and donate to local causes and fundraisers anytime there was a need. We should all strive to serve our community the "Johnny Way."
---
| |
---
## Artie Erwin
Artie Erwin, a retired Army nurse in Texarkana, started a Beds for Kids program in 2018 as a ministry of Walnut Church of Christ to provide beds for children in foster care. He now leads a team of volunteers and works with local businesses to secure donations of lumber, mattresses, and linens. Artie is a true community servant who embodies the Minuteman spirit – ready at a moment’s notice to make our community better.
---
| |
---
## Courtney Klepfer
Courtney Klepfer’s dedication to serving others, as evidenced through her work to help Tyler become just the second Texas city recognized as a Dementia Friendly Community as well as her efforts chairing the Senior Resource Committee for the Tyler Area Chamber of Commerce, is commendable.
---
| |
---
## Baxter Whitworth
Baxter Whitworth, the founder of Top Notch Cattle Company, shows us all that with hard work and dedication, anyone can achieve the American Dream, even at 12 years old. We commend Baxter for his entrepreneurial spirit.
---
| |
---
## Greg Peeler
Greg Peeler doesn’t wait for someone to ask for help. He steps up at a moment’s notice with much-needed supplies and resources when his community is in need. Thank you, Greg, for being there for your neighbors and providing a helping hand.
---
| |
---
## Gene Keenon
For the past 30 years, Gene Keenon has served over 30 communities and has put in countless hours volunteering for multiple different Chambers of Commerce, Economic Development Corporations, Rotary Clubs, and Beautification Committees. Thank you, Gene, for your dedication and passion for serving East Texas.
---
| |
---
## Deana Brown
Deana Brown has worked tirelessly to advocate for the freedom of worship across the globe by helping persecuted Christians in hostile countries relocate to places of safety. Through Freedom Seekers International, Deana has shown dedication to the East Texas values of faith, family, and freedom.
---
| |
---
## Bill Morris
An Army veteran, Bill Morris started the Panola County Veterans Relief Fund for all veterans in Panola County. This fund has helped replace roofs, keep on the utilities, and provide food, transportation, and a myriad of other needed services for veterans. Thank you, Bill, for your dedication to our community, state, and nation.
---
| |
---
## Lt. Charles Helton
As the Community Relations Officer for the Henderson Police Department, Lieutenant Charles Helton builds strong relationships across Henderson and the surrounding area. He is an active member of many local groups, has served as past president of the Chamber of Commerce, and for the past decade, Lt. Helton has worked part-time as a funeral director at Garmon Funeral Home. Thank you, Lt. Helton, for your dedication and passion for serving your community.
---

---

---
|
---
|
## Wishing You Joy During this Special Season
From my family to yours, Merry Christmas and Happy New Year.
---
|
---
| Sincerely,
---
|
---
| Nathaniel Moran Congressman, First District of Texas

I learned firsthand how our culture despises achievement

[](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=045472ab48db4bf1afa7243450c6ff6c&_e=Ru0CHOdtFLV7bML6bFWEgu_EQi2tUUIkI81e_USZs-eadLBG3LO1ZCa2pu0LiyUFNSvIpaP60dN6gPrUO6h_Vy6n9LdKDC4YUbt4dCcjsB5rYYH-bpHv-a4364O0uIqq7SRsYBUHYlT0XzE13TGzwGJN3DwuXcTtNqUhe6LkCrvva21O_Uk3nFcFcE4trbOwTizPtQRdzFZAU9e5dkdCIfbgsTDtM3XkyK6h_IcmhxZ3sTJyBY4z9d-QuQDZoh_tCUpPL4iX4dkeVms2Gfdd0o2A52dMDv4BxIRQUlzJE14%3D)
Friend,

I learned firsthand how our culture despises achievement and wishes to destroy anyone willing to challenge the status quo, big government, or the Fake News media machine.

When I was ousted from Project Veritas, two big things (one you haven't heard about) happened to me.

FIRST: The media launched a vicious smear campaign against me like I've never seen before. **Make no mistake:** _They identified this as an opportunity to "cancel" me forever_ and tried everything in their power to destroy me and everything I've ever stood for.

They failed.

SECOND: I received an OVERWHELMING amount of support from patriots across the country. These brave men and women defended me, but more importantly, they stood up for the principles of liberty and free speech.

**One of my top supporters was The Atlas Society.**

Jennifer Grossman, the CEO of The Atlas Society, proudly stood by my side and even invited me to speak with a gathering of the organization's top student leaders about free speech and how Howard Roark, the fictional hero of _The Fountainhead_ by Ayn Rand, remains my inspiration to act with integrity.

Which is why I am personally reaching out to you.

I told Jennifer I would help The Atlas Society raise $25,000 in the next 48 hours by personally contacting my online supporters. **[Please consider making an URGENT donation of any amount to The Atlas Society by clicking here.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=045472ab48db4bf1afa7243450c6ff6c&_e=Ru0CHOdtFLV7bML6bFWEgu_EQi2tUUIkI81e_USZs-eadLBG3LO1ZCa2pu0LiyUFNSvIpaP60dN6gPrUO6h_Vy6n9LdKDC4YUbt4dCcjsB5rYYH-bpHv-a4364O0uIqq7SRsYBUHYlT0XzE13TGzwCcjn7n2JileXtbGTI_zAmRPAwC9kHNGLcVAlAL6bIo0s1ds4wRiP5BGQnC2mmlQoOuncl1i7NPt8O9d1SgWfCi606nqVbtGZUhtGpVyjaYh1lN9J1OALdcOGm9IQBFhYfooi0rdU7dXwWx60mzzYhQ%3D)**

[Donate >>](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=045472ab48db4bf1afa7243450c6ff6c&_e=Ru0CHOdtFLV7bML6bFWEgu_EQi2tUUIkI81e_USZs-eadLBG3LO1ZCa2pu0LiyUFNSvIpaP60dN6gPrUO6h_Vy6n9LdKDC4YUbt4dCcjsB5rYYH-bpHv-a4364O0uIqq7SRsYBUHYlT0XzE13TGzwOb3TzcoYrTnTntn4u8CxD8UwVS033E_V7ssZ2x1BAbsnrXsUEGLayI1xYf_2L4GDCVqng742kVifVbZtZmBbC23JhDzYmBrXwKLHho6aWjYil_ZhS1P7UDB_5uV4SZcNaXtv6FIMY8QGLbxAE-EGx4%3D)

Let me tell you more about The Atlas Society and how they are fundamentally changing the direction of our country.

_I will also tell you HOW The Atlas Society is spreading its message in what I consider one of the most innovative methods I 've EVER seen a nonprofit organization engage in before._

_**_So keep reading_!**_

My mentor, Andrew Breitbart, reminds us that politics is downstream from culture. But what is culture downstream from? Answer: Philosophy. That's where The Atlas Society shines, engaging young people with the virtues of reason, achievement, and benevolent self-interest in wildly creative, artistic ways.

Have you ever read Ayn Rand's _Atlas Shrugged_ or _The Fountainhead_?

These books changed how I saw the world and my role in it.

But they are 700+ pages long!

**Jennifer shared this terrifying statistic with me:** Daily reading of books among young people has fallen from 70% in the late 1970s to 12% today.

So, how do we preserve Rand's role as the greatest all-time recruiter for liberty? That's where The Atlas Society gets creative! They leverage art and technology to create programming for "_skimmers, swimmers, and deep divers_."
**Skimmers:** Social media memes and animated videos -- every single one of their 50 posts a week gets 40K comments, shares, and likes. The "Draw My Life" videos on concepts like Capitalism, Property Rights, and Free Speech reach MILLIONS of viewers. Links invite young people on a journey for deeper intellectual exploration.

**Swimmers:** Graphic novel adaptations of Ayn Rand's shorter books, Pocket Guides that distill big concepts like Postmodernism and Socialism into a 90-minute read. Weekly podcasts with top entrepreneurs and thought-leaders, and discussion groups like "Morals & Markets."

**Deep Divers:** They recruited an all-star academic faculty of philosophers and economists who guide students on a deeper study of Rand's philosophy, publish independent work, and provide programming at their summer conference for students (the Galt's Gulch Summit, where I spoke!).

**In Case You Missed It:**
**Christie Encourages Voters To “Send A Message,” As He Kicks Off New Hampshire Swing**
**NEW HAMPSHIRE TOWN HALLS**
Governor Christie is crisscrossing New Hampshire, making the case to Granite State voters, that they have can stop Trump and send the nation a message that TRUTH MATTERS...
He will be attending town hall meetings in [Bedford](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=065d398e23&e=d0a9afa930) tonight (12/19) and [Portsmouth](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=2e27c5e0e4&e=d0a9afa930) tomorrow night (12/20). The events will begin at 6:30 PM and will be live streamed on the Tell It Like It Is PAC [Facebook](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=dac3f9b2cd&e=d0a9afa930) and [X](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=f7cf7b131a&e=d0a9afa930) pages.
“The Granite State will send a clear message to the rest of the nation on Jan. 23. It’s time to reject Donald Trump and his sycophants.” – [Chris Christie](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=1f6ebd88cd&e=d0a9afa930), CNN, 12/18/23
[](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=b88645a5bd&e=d0a9afa930)
**MAJOR ADDICTION POLICY SPEECH**
“[Gov. Christie] to give major speech on addiction policy Wed. a.m. at Hope on Haven Hill in Rochester., kicks off 3-day swing with town hall Tues. p.m. at Bedford Event Center, ends with Portsmouth house party Thurs. a.m.” – [Kevin Landrigan](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=409f5d16a2&e=d0a9afa930), New Hampshire Union Leader, 12/18/23
**CHRISTIE SHOULD STAY IN RACE**
“[Gov. Christie] also calls out the other candidates in the race for some of the action-movie scripts they are feeding the Republican base. Both Haley and DeSantis have promised that they would send U.S. Special Operations forces over the Mexican border. DeSantis even said he would have the Border Patrol [shoot migrants on sight](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=ba8d4aa30a&e=d0a9afa930) if they were suspected of running drugs.” \- [Karen Tumulty](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=412132e1cd&e=d0a9afa930), The Washington Post, 11/30/23

Friend, Here’s the latest shocker: There are 20,822 border wall panels currently sitting in storage.
That’s no exaggeration.
On Biden's first day in office, his administration suspended wall construction at the southern border. The government suddenly abandoned everything, including contractors AND materials that the previous administration had organized.

Friend,

I learned firsthand how our culture despises achievement and wishes to destroy anyone willing to challenge the status quo, big government, or the Fake News media machine.

When I was ousted from Project Veritas, two big things (one you haven't heard about) happened to me.

FIRST: The media launched a vicious smear campaign against me like I've never seen before. **Make no mistake:** _They identified this as an opportunity to "cancel" me forever_ and tried everything in their power to destroy me and everything I've ever stood for.

They failed.

SECOND: I received an OVERWHELMING amount of support from patriots across the country. These brave men and women defended me, but more importantly, they stood up for the principles of liberty and free speech.

**One of my top supporters was The Atlas Society.**

Jennifer Grossman, the CEO of The Atlas Society, proudly stood by my side and even invited me to speak with a gathering of the organization's top student leaders about free speech and how Howard Roark, the fictional hero of _The Fountainhead_ by Ayn Rand, remains my inspiration to act with integrity.

Which is why I am personally reaching out to you.

I told Jennifer I would help The Atlas Society raise $25,000 in the next 48 hours by personally contacting my online supporters. **[Please consider making an URGENT donation of any amount to The Atlas Society by clicking here.](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=e9f23816418246e29fc6f9cb45caffc5&_e=0yGKpt4G4aSgdgLiJPF2KmmVGPQzYivSiyDZsmmMnQUmlXv2kXEhK5R2MxMe5Dxi7b7ZA8KZyAfVAbR3gPmjrMwXoEtnS8B--GezRIs23VwV6pwRkzG8VLPtCETkRjVSGh5bsEFPsVT20OAJowbPpDEjY9fo5srzVU72f9gggGDZ5fI_QgTM7xRj3nPVlABB2eiNuiyRta_1TcuS4pJy1r-ykrJ8RyrY3PjPwSrv8YVgIcjmG5g8DKHw0xBGhiobWt8zqbQF0LnopACo3TwBFw1plO13ne0gqSf1Qfoz99M%3D)**

Let me tell you more about The Atlas Society and how they are fundamentally changing the direction of our country.

_I will also tell you HOW The Atlas Society is spreading its message in what I consider one of the most innovative methods I 've EVER seen a nonprofit organization engage in before._

_**_So keep reading_!**_

My mentor, Andrew Breitbart, reminds us that politics is downstream from culture. But what is culture downstream from? Answer: Philosophy. That's where The Atlas Society shines, engaging young people with the virtues of reason, achievement, and benevolent self-interest in wildly creative, artistic ways.

Have you ever read Ayn Rand's _Atlas Shrugged_ or _The Fountainhead_?

These books changed how I saw the world and my role in it.

But they are 700+ pages long!

**Jennifer shared this terrifying statistic with me:** Daily reading of books among young people has fallen from 70% in the late 1970s to 12% today.

So, how do we preserve Rand's role as the greatest all-time recruiter for liberty? That's where The Atlas Society gets creative! They leverage art and technology to create programming for "_skimmers, swimmers, and deep divers_."
**Skimmers:** Social media memes and animated videos -- every single one of their 50 posts a week gets 40K comments, shares, and likes. The "Draw My Life" videos on concepts like Capitalism, Property Rights, and Free Speech reach MILLIONS of viewers. Links invite young people on a journey for deeper intellectual exploration.

**Swimmers:** Graphic novel adaptations of Ayn Rand's shorter books, Pocket Guides that distill big concepts like Postmodernism and Socialism into a 90-minute read. Weekly podcasts with top entrepreneurs and thought-leaders, and discussion groups like "Morals & Markets."

**Deep Divers:** They recruited an all-star academic faculty of philosophers and economists who guide students on a deeper study of Rand's philosophy, publish independent work, and provide programming at their summer conference for students (the Galt's Gulch Summit, where I spoke!).

clean_body: | Hi folks, In the spirit of the holiday season, I’ve been thinking a lot lately about what brings me joy. Several things come to mind, including spending time with my niece and nephews, walking my dog, Lulu, in the park, and watching University of Illinois football games. But one of the things I’ve found brings me the most joy over the last year is being able to sit down and listen to voters. When I ran for Congress, I knew there were communities in our district that had been underserved and underrepresented for decades, and I was ready to stand up to the challenge to ensure every single person in IL-13 had a seat at the table. And since this grassroots movement helped elect me last year, I’ve done just that. Every visit, conversation, and moment with constituents fuel my efforts to go back to Washington to fight for legislation that will lower everyday costs, improve our roads and bridges, and implement safety nets for family farmers. I learned firsthand how our culture despises achievement and wishes to destroy anyone willing to challenge the status quo, big government, or the Fake News media machine.

When I was ousted from Project Veritas, two big things (one you haven't heard about) happened to me.

FIRST: The media launched a vicious smear campaign against me like I've never seen before. **Make no mistake:** _They identified this as an opportunity to "cancel" me forever_ and tried everything in their power to destroy me and everything I've ever stood for.

They failed.

SECOND: I received an OVERWHELMING amount of support from patriots across the country. These brave men and women defended me, but more importantly, they stood up for the principles of liberty and free speech.

**One of my top supporters was The Atlas Society.**

Jennifer Grossman, the CEO of The Atlas Society, proudly stood by my side and even invited me to speak with a gathering of the organization's top student leaders about free speech and how Howard Roark, the fictional hero of _The Fountainhead_ by Ayn Rand, remains my inspiration to act with integrity.

Which is why I am personally reaching out to you.

I told Jennifer I would help The Atlas Society raise $25,000 in the next 48 hours by personally contacting my online supporters. **[Please consider making an URGENT donation of any amount to The Atlas Society by clicking here.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/vM9JiYZ5xDhumZPli26K5g~~/AARclAA~/RgRnZIOSP0RcaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS90aGUtYXRsYXMtc29jaWV0eS9wYS1hY3Rpb24vP3V0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDIzMTIxOSZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1yb25XA3NwY0IKZXxN14Fliomjj1IUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)**

Let me tell you more about The Atlas Society and how they are fundamentally changing the direction of our country.

_I will also tell you HOW The Atlas Society is spreading its message in what I consider one of the most innovative methods I 've EVER seen a nonprofit organization engage in before._

_**_So keep reading_!**_

My mentor, Andrew Breitbart, reminds us that politics is downstream from culture. But what is culture downstream from? Answer: Philosophy. That's where The Atlas Society shines, engaging young people with the virtues of reason, achievement, and benevolent self-interest in wildly creative, artistic ways.

Have you ever read Ayn Rand's _Atlas Shrugged_ or _The Fountainhead_?

What if I told you that these are going to be three of the closest Senate races in the country?

Friends -
I am writing to ask if there's anything I can say to convince you to split a $10 contribution between Senators Tammy Baldwin, Bob Casey, and Amy Klobuchar's re-election campaigns before their FEC deadline comes to a close.
What if I told you that these are going to be three of the closest Senate races in the country and if even one of them loses, Democrats are likely to lose control of the Senate?
What if I told you that would be terrible news regardless of what happens in the presidential elections, but an absolute disaster if Trump somehow returns to office. Sorry to put that thought into your head — but it would be bleak?
And what if I told you that all three are facing outside attacks funded by super-wealthy far-right Republicans and they've asked for our help to fight back?
Now I know that $10 split three ways may not seem like an election-winning amount of money, but by the time you read this, quite a few people you've never met have already chipped-in their $10.
Now they're hoping you'll do the same. Because one person cannot hold the Senate by themselves — it will take all of us... together. So please:
[**Can I count on you to use this link to contribute $10 directly to Senator Casey, Baldwin and Klobuchar's re-election campaigns today? **Peter, my name is Andrea Salinas and I proudly serve Oregon’s 6th Congressional District in Congress.** With our election heating up, my friend Maxwell Frost said I could reach out to personally introduce myself and share a little about why I’m in this fight. [I’m running in one of the most competitive elections in the entire country, and I’m counting on grassroots supporters like you to help us defend this seat and preserve the progress we’ve made. If you don’t have time to read this email right now (that’s okay!), can I count on you to split a donation between Maxwell Frost and my campaign to fuel our fight for a better future?](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/2b9O8CB0AlepJ1U0jDJNRQ~~/AAPPAAA~~) My dad immigrated to the U.S. from Mexico in 1950. He believed in the power of hard work to make a difference. He worked in the fields, served two tours in Vietnam, and took a union job to provide a path into the middle class for our family.

While we didn’t have a lot growing up, my family believed that through hard work, you can achieve anything. It took me seven years to graduate college – and I juggled multiple jobs, from painting houses to pouring coffee – but I put in the hard work and earned that degree.

My daughter was born 18 years ago, and my family’s hard work gave me the determination that I needed to leave the world a better place for her. That’s why I stepped up to join the Oregon legislature.

As a state legislator, I fought for more affordable health care, helped Oregon begin to tackle our climate crisis, and passed the nation’s most progressive paid family leave bill. **It takes hard work to get these things done, but I was determined.**

**And now, I’ve brought that same level of determination to Congress.** It’s the honor of my life to fight for hard-working families – _just like yours and mine_ – every day to ensure we all have the healthcare, reproductive freedoms, quality education, clean air and water, good-paying jobs, and democratic principles that we deserve. **Peter, I know change can happen in one generation if we work for it, but we have to work together.**[That’s why I’m asking: Can I count on you to split a donation with Maxwell Frost and my people-powered campaign today? Every dollar makes a huge difference in ensuring we have the resources we need to keep fighting for you in Congress. ](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/2b9O8CB0AlepJ1U0jDJNRQ~~/AAPPAAA~~) | | | [Donate $10](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/NDk9VpZiXdXoNvgX0gDbgw~~/AAPPAAA~~)

clean_body: | ~ Peter, my name is Andrea Salinas and I proudly serve Oregon’s 6th Congressional District in Congress. With our election heating up, my friend Maxwell Frost said I could reach out to personally introduce myself and share a little about why I’m in this fight. ~ My dad immigrated to the U.S. from Mexico in 1950. He believed in the power of hard work to make a difference. He worked in the fields, served two tours in Vietnam, and took a union job to provide a path into the middle class for our family. While we didn’t have a lot growing up, my family believed that through hard work, you can achieve anything. It took me seven years to graduate college – and I juggled multiple jobs, from painting houses to pouring coffee – but I put in the hard work and earned that degree. My daughter was born 18 years ago, and my family’s hard work gave me the determination that I needed to leave the world a better place for her. That’s why I stepped up to join the Oregon legislature. As a state legislator, I fought for more affordable health care, helped Oregon begin to tackle our climate crisis, and passed the nation’s most progressive paid family leave bill. It takes hard work to get these things done, but I was determined. And now, I’ve brought that same level of determination to Congress. It’s the honor of my life to fight for hard-working families – just like yours and mine – every day to ensure we all have the healthcare, reproductive freedoms, quality education, clean air and water, good-paying jobs, and democratic principles that we deserve. subject: Don’t Be Fooled by NW Natural Hype!
body:
| | | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/75458465/444735938/2023226255?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImJmM2M1ZTJmLTljOWUtZWUxMS1iZWExLTAwMjI0ODIyM2YzNiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=fR0_U7a3XNmnSBojbPv4ZM1bKhTY08lh6laDnmEn6V8=&emci=5515369c-979e-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&emdi=bf3c5e2f-9c9e-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&ceid=2107230) Dear Friend, Suing the state to delay climate action. Funding an expensive overseas trip for lawmakers. Bankrolling misleading testimony. It seems NW Natural Gas will try just about anything to continue polluting the climate and the air in our homes. Their latest dirty trick: Promoting the prospect of hydrogen in our homes to Oregon lawmakers — a risky, costly, and unrealistic alternative to their already dangerous and unhealthy methane gas. We cannot allow this misleading and harmful hydrogen hype to go unchallenged. Burning hydrogen in buildings is dangerous for climate and public health – releasing up to 6x more polluting nitrogen oxide (NOx) than methane gas when burned. [**Can we count on you to alert your legislators to this misinformation campaign and push back on NW Natural’s latest smokescreen?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/75458466/444735940/2023226255?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImJmM2M1ZTJmLTljOWUtZWUxMS1iZWExLTAwMjI0ODIyM2YzNiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=fR0_U7a3XNmnSBojbPv4ZM1bKhTY08lh6laDnmEn6V8=&emci=5515369c-979e-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&emdi=bf3c5e2f-9c9e-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&ceid=2107230) With their deep pockets and downplaying of climate and public health harms, it seems NW Natural will pay and say anything to distract from the fact that electrification is the safest and cleanest energy option for heating, cooling, hot water, and cooking. It’s up to us to sound the alarm on NW Natural’s troubling record, which includes:
* Funding a trip to Denmark for Oregon lawmakers alongside a NW Natural lobbyist and top company executives, apparently to promote so-called “renewable natural gas” — biomethane gas — which is costly, has a significant carbon footprint, and faces major production constraints.1
* Deploying deceptive marketing tactics straight out of Big Tobacco’s playbook, including paying a toxicologist who testified to Multnomah County commissioners and downplayed the public health risks of cooking with gas — despite decades of evidence to the contrary — without disclosing her NW Natural funding.2
* Spending a million dollars to fight electrification efforts in Eugene and Milwaukie that would protect public health and empower local communities to reduce pollution.3
* Suing the state to undermine our Climate Protection Program, a historic effort to turn the tide on the climate crisis in Oregon and benefit communities.4

And that’s just some of the lowlights. The public and policymakers deserve transparency, not this fossil fuel-funded smokescreen. With your help, we can start to shed some light. [**Email your lawmakers TODAY and warn them not to buy NW Natural Hype!**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/75458468/444735941/2023226255?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImJmM2M1ZTJmLTljOWUtZWUxMS1iZWExLTAwMjI0ODIyM2YzNiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=fR0_U7a3XNmnSBojbPv4ZM1bKhTY08lh6laDnmEn6V8=&emci=5515369c-979e-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&emdi=bf3c5e2f-9c9e-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&ceid=2107230)
Thank you, Julia DeGraw
Coalition Director, OLCV

From: Riley Gaines <rileygaines@email.leadershipinstitute.org>
Send Date: August 9, 2023 9:55 AM
Subject: Did you see my announcement?

Dear Friend,

I hope you saw my announcement on Sean Hannity's show that I've partnered with the Leadership Institute to launch the Riley Gaines Center.

I'm the 12-time All-American swimmer who speaks out against transgender ideology and fights to defend basic truths - that men are men and women are women.

The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute is now the exclusive headquarters of my work to lead conservatives of all types - patriots who will not be silenced by the weight of the left's cultural pressure and who want to learn how to defend America's freedoms.

When the left tries to shout you down profanely, when they viciously attack you - that's when you know you're saying the right things.

For those who are attacked, vilified, and persecuted for their support of America's founding principles and traditional American values, the Riley Gaines Center sends a message that they are not alone - because I will stand bravely with them.

To train as many young people as I can to stand up for conservative principles, I must have the help of strong Leadership Institute supporters like you.

**[Will you help turn young men and women into Leaders for America?](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b337aa6471a744909c7247edca627535&_e=-mPBic8SF3Zq7QMt19xQ2LybS0PXXnsni4OvkUJfHvzZO1a5KvsnE361V3pr2FWaCNNeUKGWxZ86oPooh1R4Zy89J0sCjeuviWsp_xbbek-oXlAPkPOh-NQEzpssolS32OsOojuLPFBr5hWkLyyc84hwsHDlXJBRn5-TATbwV0vKXw0xb7PHtGhySHxRW4IF8T0e1VQjXbZQn-mwKtd82dAkbFvzmBFXlsnFilI7GoEgOk8odUgH_BpISfoQv4pG9TYwSnJCPwcgLPlNDgTEA87cDVNPu4v5vZpd6p755uiosyVxIP1BqkMmtuP2H5cpypYZgaQ59hZ9VvVCydijp4UeB7ioR7iPBQNvt-ehBNk%3D)**

The Riley Gaines Center is the exclusive home of my work to lead this crucial cause through:
* Speaking events and media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women's identity and uphold vital truths.

* A coalition of women, student athletes, parents, and those who have been harmed by radical transgender ideology, to join me in speaking out across the country.

* A fast-growing team of speakers and grassroots organizers, who will help turn those ready to defend freedom into champions who put their principles into action.

---
Through the Riley Gaines Center, my fellow Leadership Institute colleagues and I will identify, recruit, train, mentor, and empower students, athletes, and parents across the country to become campus, community, and national Leaders for America.

Not only will these young leaders help our country right now. They will stand up for our principles for decades to come.

**[By joining me and the Leadership Institute team with your contribution to this new effort, you make a powerful difference for conservatives across the country, from college campuses to the halls of power.](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b337aa6471a744909c7247edca627535&_e=-mPBic8SF3Zq7QMt19xQ2LybS0PXXnsni4OvkUJfHvzZO1a5KvsnE361V3pr2FWaCNNeUKGWxZ86oPooh1R4Zy89J0sCjeuviWsp_xbbek-oXlAPkPOh-NQEzpssolS32OsOojuLPFBr5hWkLyyc84hwsHDlXJBRn5-TATbwV0vKXw0xb7PHtGhySHxRW4IF8T0e1VQjXbZQn-mwKtd82Z-UBCRcVTrzwed4XhKtdyANLt1Apv4DLH7_PXFocmdM3JiqdFHXLjzhdPFO1N5xm9Mxciqhy30igzBQZilz6AErBE6P8Mz3fqD_kqEaHGBb8smh6hZZ95ayNKYdAXt_x28FRpOTewRBWsKlTAYSjDo%3D)**

Thank you for your support and dedication to preserving commonsense truths and conservative principles in our country.

Stand bravely with me,

Riley Gaines
The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

| | | Rudy Giuliani was just ordered to pay $148 MILLION to two Georgia election workers for spreading dangerous lies and conspiracy theories about them after the 2020 election. But even that can't get him to keep his mouth shut! Giuliani continued to defame the election workers, Ruby Freeman and her daughter, Wandrea "Shaye" Moss, even after the verdict was handed down. So Freeman and Moss are suing Rudy Giuliani again – and he deserves it for making their lives hell! The new [lawsuit](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tdb173d67-4422-4c2f-b659-aa0c01d25e38/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) seeks "a permanent injunction from the federal court in Washington, DC, to be placed on Giuliani that would prohibit him 'from making or publishing, or causing to be made or published, further statements repeating any and all false claims' about Freeman and Moss. Rudy Giuliani clearly hasn't learned any lessons – he should be fully held accountable for the dangerous lies he continues to spread. Did you know that my race last year was one of the closest in the nation? Yep, that’s right. I won my race by only 10,109 votes. That’s all that separated me from my Democrat opponent in the 2022 election. Everybody told me I couldn’t defeat my opponent. I’m nothing special—I’m not a career politician—just a Mom, Veteran, and Nurse Practitioner who wants to honestly help people. https://click.contact.jenforcongress.com/?qs=b6e6dfcd74fd47687f92a7d6288128838549fb4a9d382889e8c026ee6fdb9ab630a23817c3eca9dc2361633e55dcaf738e5e50193f617b51 I ran for office because I got tired of just watching the evening news and hearing about all the dysfunction in politics. I decided to step up and actually do something about it. But despite the odds stacked against me, and the millions my opponent spent trying to take me down, I flipped a Democrat-held seat RED last year in one of the closest races in the entire nation. But our fight is far from over, Peter. In order to truly help people and make real changes on Capitol Hill, I need to defend my seat next year from the far-Left’s power grabs. They have (will continue) to throw everything they can at us in hopes of taking back my seat… I served 10 years in the Navy, and I promise I won’t go down without a fight. But I need your help to make sure we hold onto this seat and the Republican Majority. https://click.contact.jenforcongress.com/?qs=b6e6dfcd74fd47687f92a7d6288128838549fb4a9d382889e8c026ee6fdb9ab630a23817c3eca9dc2361633e55dcaf738e5e50193f617b51 STAND WITH JEN I understand the challenges that veterans, families, and seniors face, and I'm committed to being a voice of reason who will always put my community first. clean_body: Together, we will keep demanding a permanent ceasefire. | | | Friend, Right now, we are seeing two very different visions for the future of America and the world. Last week, Congress approved giving $886 billion of our tax dollars to fund bombs, weapons, and war crimes. I voted against this massively wasteful budget for war and destruction, which was the largest military budget in the history of our country. This budget is impossible to justify when our neighbors are struggling to put food on the table, fighting to keep a roof over their heads, and rationing their medication. My constituents sent me to Congress to invest in life and in everyday working people. Last week, I was proud to stand alongside United Auto Workers (UAW) President Shawn Fain and other union leaders calling for a ceasefire now. At the ceasefire rally, UAW President Shawn Fain said: “The world has seen enough slaughter and devastation. Peace is the only path forward... As union members, we know we must fight for all workers and suffering people around the world. We must fight for humanity.” My Yaba (dad) was a UAW member and I wish he was alive today to see his union stand up and courageously say: Ceasefire now! But even as our movement demanding a ceasefire grows, Congress continues to fund more bombs and more senseless killing. Why aren’t over 18,000 Palestinians killed enough for my colleagues to say the words, ‘Ceasefire now’? Why aren’t over 7,000 children killed enough for my colleagues to call for a lasting ceasefire for an end to this war? Do you know the truth about Bob’s opponent in this race?
He’s a mega-millionaire who can spend huge amounts to self-fund his campaign.
He’s Mitch McConnell’s hand-picked candidate as the GOP fights to flip PA red and retake Senate control.
He supports an extreme abortion ban with no exceptions for rape or incest.
**He also has a decades-long record of selling out working people and shipping jobs overseas — to enrich himself and his Wall Street friends.**
Seriously. Our opponent couldn’t be more different than Bob, who has a long record of fighting to lower costs for working families, bringing jobs to the Commonwealth, and strengthening Pennsylvania’s manufacturing industry.

name: Sheridan at United We Dream Action
subject: My immigration status interfered with my dreams
body:
Our immigration system is designed to keep people living in the shadows. | | | Peter, Growing up in Texas, my dream was to work in the film industry. I always loved movies, and I spent my high school years doing plays, musicals, and video production. I dreamed of studying theater in college and worked hard in my classes to make it happen — graduating as valedictorian in 2012. But even though I auditioned for several theater schools, I was unable to accept admission to any of them because I was undocumented. **But soon after, immigrant youth won DACA!** Because of that, I was able to attend the University of Texas and study theater and filmmaking. It wasn’t always easy. I often felt alone, as one of the only students writing and producing stories with immigrant and LGBTQ protagonists. **However, my UWD community always had my back and helped me feel less alone.** People have been looking out for me my whole life. My parents worked incredibly hard to give me and my siblings a better life. When I was in high school, there were organizers and movement leaders fighting for my rights — unbeknownst to me. They cared for me and my story without ever having met me. Now, I’m honored to pick up that fight and fight for all immigrants and their stories, whether they realize it or not. That’s why I’m coming to you today. UWDA fights for all immigrants and their stories, and our work is powered by the support of our community — that means folks like you! Our end-of-year giving campaign is incredibly important, because it powers all the work we’ll be able to do next year advancing immigrants’ rights. **So, Peter, can you make a contribution of any amount today to support United We Dream Action’s work? clean_body: Our immigration system is designed to keep people living in the shadows. | | | Peter, Growing up in Texas, my dream was to work in the film industry. I always loved movies, and I spent my high school years doing plays, musicals, and video production. I dreamed of studying theater in college and worked hard in my classes to make it happen — graduating as valedictorian in 2012. But even though I auditioned for several theater schools, I was unable to accept admission to any of them because I was undocumented. But soon after, immigrant youth won DACA! Because of that, I was able to attend the University of Texas and study theater and filmmaking. It wasn’t always easy. I often felt alone, as one of the only students writing and producing stories with immigrant and LGBTQ protagonists. However, my UWD community always had my back and helped me feel less alone. People have been looking out for me my whole life. My parents worked incredibly hard to give me and my siblings a better life. When I was in high school, there were organizers and movement leaders fighting for my rights — unbeknownst to me. They cared for me and my story without ever having met me. Now, I’m honored to pick up that fight and fight for all immigrants and their stories, whether they realize it or not. That’s why I’m coming to you today. UWDA fights for all immigrants and their stories, and our work is powered by the support of our community — that means folks like you! Our end-of-year giving campaign is incredibly important, because it powers all the work we’ll be able to do next year advancing immigrants’ rights. subject: Justice Thomas keeps giving us more and more reasons to pass this legislation.

body:
This week ProPublica reported that in 2000, Justice Clarence Thomas was in debt, and complained to a Republican congressman about his “modest” $173,600 salary

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=1860%2E4032634%2EipBWa5)
---
Another piece of the ever-evolving Justice Clarence Thomas jigsaw puzzle just clicked into place. This week ProPublica reported that in 2000, Justice Clarence Thomas was in debt, and complained to a Republican congressman about his “modest” $173,600 salary (more than $300,000 in today’s dollars) and lifestyle on the Supreme Court. (Not long before this conversation, Justice Thomas had borrowed $267,000 from a wealthy friend to buy a high-end RV.) He told the congressman that Supreme Court justices should get a raise, or else “one or more justices will leave soon.” He was looking for other ways to juice his income, too — like removing a ban on justices giving paid speeches. This conversation apparently had Republicans scared that Justice Thomas would resign. After the conversation Justice Thomas received a letter from the congressman that said, “I intend to look into a bill to raise the salaries of members of The Supreme Court. As we agreed, it is worth a lot to Americans to have the constitution properly interpreted. We must have the proper incentives here, too.” In other words: Message received. And lo and behold, Republican billionaires were happy to give him a lavish lifestyle so he wouldn’t resign from the Supreme Court. In the years that followed, he infamously received undisclosed gifts and favors spanning from superyacht rides to private jet flights to stays at high-end resorts to premium suites at sporting events — to private boarding school tuition covered for his grandnephew and his family’s real estate properties being bought and renovated. It's corruption, plain and simple. Allowing the rich and powerful to give secret gifts to Supreme Court justices undermines our judicial system’s ideal of Equal Justice Under Law. And, keeping some of these gifts and favors undisclosed is against the law. **I’m still fighting to make Supreme Court justices follow a basic code of ethics, including tightening rules on gifts like the ones Justice Thomas has been showered with. It’s all part of my work to root corruption out of Washington and make our government work for everyone, not just the rich and powerful.** [**And grassroots donors make it possible for me to stay in the fight to advocate for these plans. Can you pitch in $28 or any amount to our re-election campaign? Every donation powers our movement to root out corruption in Washington and put our government on the side of working people.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/1049?amount=28&t=8&akid=1860%2E4032634%2EipBWa5)

I’m going to keep pushing what my Judicial Ethics and Anti-Corruption Act would accomplish — because it’s important we spread awareness about this plan, and Justice Thomas just keeps giving us more and more reasons to pass it. Here’s some of what this plan would do:
* Make the Supreme Court follow a binding Code of Conduct
* Ban federal judges from owning or trading individual stocks
* Tighten restrictions on gifts and privately funded travel (yes, Justice Clarence Thomas, I’m looking at you)
* Overhaul the broken recusal process (once again looking at you, Justice Thomas, after you didn’t recuse yourself from a case around the insurrection that could possibly have had consequences for your wife)
* Create new tools to hold judges accountable for ethical misconduct

Meanwhile, I’m also fighting to...
* Ban all individual stock ownership by members of Congress, Cabinet secretaries, senior congressional staff, federal judges, White House staff, and other senior agency officials while in office
* End lobbying as we know it
* Padlock the revolving door between big businesses and our government
* Limit the influence of private defense contractors on our military
* Keep big bank executives off Federal Reserve Bank boards of directors
* Create a new, independent anti-corruption agency dedicated to enforcing federal ethics laws
* And more

I’m not alone in this fight. I’ve got some terrific partners in Washington. And I know that I’m fighting alongside you too. **Together, we can remove the toxic influence that big money has on our government. And we can pass policies that put power in the hands of working people, where it belongs.** [**I’ll keep fighting to root corruption out of our federal judiciary, and I need you in this fight by my side. If you’re able, can you please chip in $28 or anything you can to support our campaign? This issue is powerfully important to our democracy, and your support helps ensure we can keep fighting to pass this plan.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/1049?amount=28&t=14&akid=1860%2E4032634%2EipBWa5) Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

This week ProPublica reported that in 2000, Justice Clarence Thomas was in debt, and complained to a Republican congressman about his “modest” $173,600 salary (more than $300,000 in today’s dollars) and lifestyle on the Supreme Court. (Not long before this conversation, Justice Thomas had borrowed $267,000 from a wealthy friend to buy a high-end RV.) He told the congressman that Supreme Court justices should get a raise, or else “one or more justices will leave soon.” He was looking for other ways to juice his income, too — like removing a ban on justices giving paid speeches. This conversation apparently had Republicans scared that Justice Thomas would resign. After the conversation Justice Thomas received a letter from the congressman that said, “I intend to look into a bill to raise the salaries of members of The Supreme Court. As we agreed, it is worth a lot to Americans to have the constitution properly interpreted. We must have the proper incentives here, too.” In other words: Message received. And lo and behold, Republican billionaires were happy to give him a lavish lifestyle so he wouldn’t resign from the Supreme Court. In the years that followed, he infamously received undisclosed gifts and favors spanning from superyacht rides to private jet flights to stays at high-end resorts to premium suites at sporting events — to private boarding school tuition covered for his grandnephew and his family’s real estate properties being bought and renovated. It's corruption, plain and simple. Allowing the rich and powerful to give secret gifts to Supreme Court justices undermines our judicial system’s ideal of Equal Justice Under Law. And, keeping some of these gifts and favors undisclosed is against the law. I’m still fighting to make Supreme Court justices follow a basic code of ethics, including tightening rules on gifts like the ones Justice Thomas has been showered with. It’s all part of my work to root corruption out of Washington and make our government work for everyone, not just the rich and powerful. If you've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically: | | | | | | | I’m going to keep pushing what my Judicial Ethics and Anti-Corruption Act would accomplish — because it’s important we spread awareness about this plan, and Justice Thomas just keeps giving us more and more reasons to pass it. Here’s some of what this plan would do: Make the Supreme Court follow a binding Code of Conduct Ban federal judges from owning or trading individual stocks Tighten restrictions on gifts and privately funded travel (yes, Justice Clarence Thomas, I’m looking at you) Overhaul the broken recusal process (once again looking at you, Justice Thomas, after you didn’t recuse yourself from a case around the insurrection that could possibly have had consequences for your wife) Create new tools to hold judges accountable for ethical misconduct Meanwhile, I’m also fighting to... Ban all individual stock ownership by members of Congress, Cabinet secretaries, senior congressional staff, federal judges, White House staff, and other senior agency officials while in office End lobbying as we know it Padlock the revolving door between big businesses and our government Limit the influence of private defense contractors on our military Keep big bank executives off Federal Reserve Bank boards of directors Create a new, independent anti-corruption agency dedicated to enforcing federal ethics laws And more I’m not alone in this fight. I’ve got some terrific partners in Washington. And I know that I’m fighting alongside you too. Together, we can remove the toxic influence that big money has on our government. And we can pass policies that put power in the hands of working people, where it belongs. Peter, We're reaching out with an urgent update on the battle for fair elections. This sinister plan is spreading like wildfire. Wisconsin, Ohio, Georgia, and Arizona are now in the crosshairs, with activists pushing for RCV and attempting to change the rules to suit their agenda.

---
[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=259738ab68b8426f85151c3710001a29&_e=Mu-35xZryD1Z9TINSrbGkq7T2SvP5xyosYi_dtQjisXgXEkHMOtlBBIkHv6TTksRlCzihBf1oHEl7jy5IOaluarz--VtrMZ9q0SIiDRlI663P-TrqaeEhaFtH8XePuhRIUDKOkHC5KH0oHklLYHA2_dowbbEvjB6yZB49kLN1xwgttjLUHtjOXB1PT-X5w-YKJ0RpSBBjfVz-1kkN_ZqMEiGrq4ABHfNOllB7kCaOWSLSDCa4u5zbG4n2vI2MSFgU5VfHGWVjdmiRM-rQULozj1eRfPd5IiLeOV5CRkcXvufje7t_vzv_oDxpz873K3UW8U4VhdC_45Y7I_03DkT4KO4C-uV6psRGQ9Q633FunM%3D)
---
We cannot let them capture any of these states. Ranked Choice Voting poses a dire threat to the integrity of our elections...

**👉Take Action:** **_[https://voter-reference-foundation.revv.co/action-rcv](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=259738ab68b8426f85151c3710001a29&_e=Mu-35xZryD1Z9TINSrbGkq7T2SvP5xyosYi_dtQjisXgXEkHMOtlBBIkHv6TTksRlCzihBf1oHEl7jy5IOaluarz--VtrMZ9q0SIiDRlI663P-TrqaeEhaFtH8XePuhRIUDKOkHC5KH0oHklLYHA2_dowbbEvjB6yZB49kLN1xwgttjLUHtjOXB1PT-X5w-YKJ0RpSBBjfVz-1kkN_ZqMJ8yQodjzA2fJNu6oXz3L5Lw1ad73nIGr3FB5Df7toyyGimWuWwuXxKoULSTK7fQIjpTA0ME8-uBP4aNHTVv4BFpEsGVOK1UiSeODF7FQ1Un46ZLGiGdlx0MLH02h3_THdGk_RxGC-9L34pfaFdOoOw%3D)_**

RCV allows for calculated voting strategies that may lead to outcomes that do not accurately reflect the will of the people. The potential for abuse and the distortion of election results is a risk we cannot afford to take.

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

body:
A Giving Christmas |
---
| | [ ](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=5eac24385c&e=1090c5c412)

|
---
| Dear Friends and Neighbors,

This photo of me with three-year old twins Melody and Kevin was taken at the Care Net Christmas Party in Lehighton on Sunday. I told Kevin he had the coolest name at the party.

Our campaign is in the middle of our "Giving Christmas" series of holiday receptions to benefit local charities. It's been an inspiring and rewarding week.

On Thursday, we accepted donations from dozens of people at [Korny’s Tavern](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=88d9897786&e=1090c5c412) in Coplay to help the **[Allentown Rescue Mission](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=57410517a6&e=1090c5c412) **get homeless men back on track. We delivered a whole truckload of linens, socks and personal care items to the Mission.

On Saturday, we had a reception at the [Original Doughboys Pizza and Family Restaurant](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=5e65ff7ffd&e=1090c5c412) in Wind Gap. We filled up an entire van with shoes, clothing, and supplies for **[Victory House Lehigh Valley](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=8584012d10&e=1090c5c412) **to benefit homeless veterans and men in need.

Then on Monday, we met at [The Batter's Box Sports Bar & Grille](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=2ffa34d1fb&e=1090c5c412) in Summit Hill, where workers from **[Care Net Carbon County](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=7e0150ba99&e=1090c5c412) **collected a carload of diapers, gift cards, and toys for local women and families. Those donations benefit children like Melody and Kevin.

We have one more event this Thursday, Dec. 21 from 6-8 PM at [Cherry Family Restaurant](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=e80ed65db5&e=1090c5c412), 593 Interchange Rd, Kresgeville. We'll be collecting clothing, bar soap, disposable razors, deodorant, and personal items for the homeless Veterans at **[Valor Clinic](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=c7c330ff0a&e=1090c5c412)** in Kunkletown (**[Details Here](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=070bcc594b&e=1090c5c412)**). We hope you can make it.

I want to say a special thank you to our hosts, meal preparers, and volunteers who have been contributing generously to these events. We appreciate what you do.

After Christmas, my congressional campaign will focus once again on my plans for Safe Communities, Good Jobs, and Strong Families. But for now, let's all enjoy the holidays, help our friends in need, and remember what this season is all about. God Bless.

**Keep America Free.**

_Kevin Dellicker is a Republican from Heidelberg Township, Lehigh County, running for U.S. House of Representatives in Pa.’s 7th District. He is a 28-year military veteran, technology company owner, husband and father to three sons. He’s not a career politician. He’s an experienced leader with the courage and expertise to Keep America Free. Learn more at[www.dellickerforcongress.com](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=60b279166e&e=1090c5c412)._

I'm proud of my dad. On Saturday, Col Willard Dellicker (Ret.) represented the US Air Force at the [Wreaths Across America](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=26a26fffa4&e=1090c5c412) ceremony honoring veterans at [Resurrection Cemetery](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=2fd069ec08&e=1090c5c412) in Allentown. To my donors, friends and supporters,

First and foremost, happy holidays to all! I️ hope you enjoy time well spent with friends and family. Your commitment to our campaign has been instrumental in bringing us closer to building a better, stronger Indiana.

As we near the close of this pivotal quarter, I'm reaching out with deep gratitude and a humble request for your continued support.

Whether through a recurring contribution or a one-time gift of any amount, your generosity is integral to our success.
https://secure.winred.com/friends-of-suzanne-crouch/web?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=c4c89d93ea-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_12_19_02_28&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c4c89d93ea-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

** Why Your Support Matters:
------------------------------------------------------------

https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=c4c89d93ea-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_12_19_02_28&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c4c89d93ea-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Indiana stands at a crossroads, and the challenges we face demand bold leadership.

As your governor, I am committed to taking the necessary steps to grow our economy, attract jobs, and uphold the cherished values that define us as Hoosiers.

** 'Bidenomics' is hurting Hoosiers (https://www.realclearpolitics.com/articles/2023/12/12/economic_angst_in_the_heartland_150187.html?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=c4c89d93ea-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_12_19_02_28&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c4c89d93ea-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) , and we can do something about it
------------------------------------------------------------

Bidenomics is crushing American households, favoring a privileged class and leaving the majority "stressed, polarized, and losing faith in society’s future."

By mid-2024, only the top 1% will be better off than before the pandemic, JP Morgan economist Marko Kolanovic projects.

https://www.cbsnews.com/news/inflation-households-need-extra-11400-these-states-its-even-higher/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=c4c89d93ea-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_12_19_02_28&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c4c89d93ea-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

In Indiana, we understand the urgency to address these challenges. By axing the state's individual income tax, we can bring tangible relief to ALL Hoosier households.

It's time for leaders to step up and take action. Enough is enough.

** Here's how I'm fighting for YOU
------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=c4c89d93ea-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_12_19_02_28&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c4c89d93ea-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

ADVOCATING FOR OUR VISION:

* Gubernatorial Panel at the Dentons Legislative Conference
* Randolph County Candidate Forum
* Columbus Economic Development Candidate Forum

https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=c4c89d93ea-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_12_19_02_28&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c4c89d93ea-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

MEETING WITH LAW ENFORCEMENT LEADERS:

* Indy FOP President Rick Snyder
* Indiana State Police Alliance President Scott Krueger
* Professional Fire Fighters Union of Indiana
* Fort Wayne FOP President Mitch McKinney
* First responders in Carmel

https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana/posts/pfbid02GzTuPbicxkX4JpMQmZLZ8A4RmxWWU3gbAp97bwiFfUQkCZAvBoDEZXZh5XH4fKWHl?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=c4c89d93ea-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_12_19_02_28&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c4c89d93ea-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

PRIORITIZING MENTAL HEALTH:
Indiana's mental health crisis has a staggering human cost and profound impact on all those who serve and protect us.

I've testified, fought, and stood up for expanded resources, and as Governor, I'll keep fighting to ensure every Hoosier has the chance to thrive.

Thank you all for your unwavering support. I️ hope you have a very Merry Christmas with family and friends and that your New Year is the happiest of all.

| | Friend, I’m sure you’ve heard by now that the Supreme Court has agreed to hear another case about abortion access. This time, it’s about mifepristone, a medication that is used in over half of abortions in America. If the Court decides like it has in past abortion cases, it would make it _substantially_ harder to receive necessary reproductive healthcare. We’ve seen this Court’s aggressive anti-abortion stance before in _Dobbs_ , and people across the country have suffered because of it. I’m sure you saw the recent story about the Texas woman who had to flee to get a life saving abortion. It’s sick: people are being forced to go to the courts for approval to end a pregnancy, even when their lives are in danger. **[**Restricting abortion access puts people in dangerous situations and if the Supreme Court upholds this decision, more people will be put in harm's way. Finally, after decades of conservative mega-donor influence, the far right has chipped away at one of our most fundamental rights: the right to choose. If you think this Court has gone too far and we must reform the Court, please chip in $10 now so we can keep working to fight to pass these critical reforms.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/75461238/444746146/444630146?refcode=12-19-2023&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNS8xLzkwOTg3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjFhZDMwN2VlLWExOWUtZWUxMS1iZWExLTAwMjI0ODIyM2YzNiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=0qQtmeC0DAo7GkaDaYXMg9J7Zi-WP0CDeIZb_PNVD9o=)** This Supreme Court is corrupt, and it’s no secret. Justices are jet-setting with billionaires and rubbing shoulders with conservative mega-donors all while casting aside the duties of their position. As conservatives continue to have significant sway over the Court’s decisions, it’s more important than ever to protect abortion rights throughout the country. body:

This sponsored message from Reclaiming American Freedom is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=f29f58417bd345818666fee25c7945b1&_e=TQgozxh5QFJUg78phXsJpW8FwOEo1VUFhWHa9OCKTJoM1JrBUlveJ3X7zPg8Twpq1Lc8_CcUdmiLLLjDEEHq5iRNLBtAZDpUcwJWa5KqXELL7hTSfvc-WoeP3oY9Hyyw695pFr-_qegZeYTz9GAKt-k9fPKvDzsR0Mp2ssKKSgogCgqtq3czGKKXZ7i8G0Mr587SwrZk0qdWT9_JFgakfRPalUB57-RELaRdHWhbRb1pL4HsLwl9O2RDSkAFNT0X5xwTqTsdOFascciE9QJlBlslzf09v_E-bwgOYUremuXpTXZiBREEZOGJCsnSe1a1EGBq5eFX87jJiF27oKHvVfH4hSsdXh6CZ_ilFC-lObD_ULWRMlaA9IqVcOtmag_8hYQX9NOmZM7U0yrvHqXJYg%3D%3D) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it... Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints **That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=f29f58417bd345818666fee25c7945b1&_e=TQgozxh5QFJUg78phXsJpW8FwOEo1VUFhWHa9OCKTJoM1JrBUlveJ3X7zPg8Twpq1Lc8_CcUdmiLLLjDEEHq5iRNLBtAZDpUcwJWa5KqXELL7hTSfvc-WoeP3oY9Hyyw695pFr-_qegZeYTz9GAKt-k9fPKvDzsR0Mp2ssKKSgogCgqtq3czGKKXZ7i8G0Mr587SwrZk0qdWT9_JFgakfRPalUB57-RELaRdHWhbRb0oiXkuC4D_neJ-LvE13-glolWy-wPCuSOcIzzeB7lKCI99MVXFPfLPeF9YDF18dRJzjenM-tHDPfBaws0n3WNj8FDrt8_s2qpFJOqH-h0QtTy2jWeV7t-V2oA4Slpjm2_y_--cHIcITYjvt0zIafa482iEe-IDxPqV1om3kzX7_A%3D%3D)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include: **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=f29f58417bd345818666fee25c7945b1&_e=TQgozxh5QFJUg78phXsJpW8FwOEo1VUFhWHa9OCKTJoM1JrBUlveJ3X7zPg8Twpq1Lc8_CcUdmiLLLjDEEHq5iRNLBtAZDpUcwJWa5KqXELL7hTSfvc-WoeP3oY9Hyyw695pFr-_qegZeYTz9GAKt-k9fPKvDzsR0Mp2ssKKSgogCgqtq3czGKKXZ7i8G0Mr587SwrZk0qdWT9_JFgakfRPalUB57-RELaRdHWhbRb2eb9fu80oIRvY1VW0XuUR96wMORm4C1plFb59nFGHmAZhCJFbMn-BfZMGox7y4J0_OqZcD0D8mrTdWs66QFRZQXt4NBYGGYCGZyEvpcLh0chkKrd7DH1MlC-VIMA6FCxV4_X-5JakwXkIIje8FjMUyRhAFVTR4w3orhUk4VLJlEA%3D%3D)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. We were a much smaller organization in 1991, when women across the country were fed up with anti-choice extremists making decisions about our fundamental rights. (Sound familiar?!) That anger inspired a nationwide demand for better representation, and the growing EMILYs List community laid the groundwork for a sea change in American politics. We started early, and our efforts were born out on Election Day 1992.

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

name: Treasurer Read
subject: End-of-Year Campaign Update
body:
www.tobiasread.com [www.tobiasread.com]
Dear Peter,
As the year draws to a close, I want to share with you the great work our campaign has been able to accomplish since our launch in September.
Our first priority has been hearing directly from voters and elections administrators on the front lines of keeping our elections accessible and secure. Since the fall, we have been on the road across Oregon. We have spent time in Coos Bay and other coastal communities and made trips to Central and Eastern Oregon, including stops in Prineville and Pendleton. We have also been putting in the miles on I-5 from Portland to Ashland. We have heard from voters about how we can restore trust and accountability in the Secretary of State’s office. And in recent weeks, I’ve met with over half of Oregon’s 36 county clerks to hear their ideas for how to make Oregon’s voting process more secure and accessible for everyone.
We also recently brought on a fantastic new campaign manager, Andrea Phillips . Andrea and I have known each other since we volunteered together on the Clinton/Gore campaign as high school students in 1992. Since then, Andrea has served as vice chair of the Iowa Democratic Party and ran for the Iowa Legislature, where she more than doubled the statewide legislative fundraising record. She’s bringing her talents and energy to Oregon to help me win this race. She is a high-energy leader with a wealth of campaign experience—from school board to presidential races—and we are lucky to have her. Please feel free to drop her a note and share your ideas for the campaign at andrea@tobiasread.com.
I’m also really proud to have received a number of special endorsements. At the top of the list are two former Secretaries of State: Former Oregon Governor Barbara Roberts and Jeanne Atkins . They’ve done this job, they know what it takes, and I’m honored to have their support. I’m also proud to have the support of Congresswoman Andrea Salinas , Senate Co-Chair of Ways and Means Elizabeth Steiner , and former State Treasurer Jim Hill . We are also grateful to have the support of 15 (and counting) current and former legislators, in addition to mayors, city councilors, school board members, and community leaders from across Oregon. Be on the lookout for other important endorsements over the next few weeks.
Your financial support is essential to getting the word out about our campaign in 2024. Can you help us keep the momentum going with a donation of $20 today [https://www.cesystems.tech/campaign/friendsoftobiasread] ? As we turn the calendar to 2024, we are also looking for folks who will put up lawn signs, knock doors, host house parties, and help out in other ways. If you are ready to do any of those (or other!) things, please sign up here [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSerS9CZmz4XTFH-AQhSTPbW4FEo-fUiEt5KiZGx1ivNEEZnCQ/viewform?usp=sf_link] .
As we continue to build our campaign, your support in this election will help us restore trust and accountability in the Secretary of State’s office.
Many thanks,
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP07/1/77260/images/TR%20signature.png]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP07/1/77260/images/Alteza_films_Tobias%20Reed%20-174.jpg]
P.S. We need your help getting our campaign’s message out. Your support today means more voters will hear from us. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/readforsecretaryofstate?refcode=25anniversary]
